paragraphs.en: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
paragraphs.zh: 潜在稀疏注意力：迈向次二次复杂度的超长上下文注意力

paragraphs.en: Ales Kubicek * 1 Andrea Caciolai * 1 Liangzu Peng * 1 Sukrit Sumant 1 Benjamin Hoover 1 Fraser Greenlee 1 Ruairidh M. Battleday 1 Radim Urban 2 Torsten Hoefler 2 James C.R. Whittington † 1
paragraphs.zh: Ales Kubicek * 1 Andrea Caciolai * 1 梁祖鹏 * 1 Sukrit Sumant 1 Benjamin Hoover 1 Fraser Greenlee 1 Ruairidh M. Battleday 1 Radim Urban 2 Torsten Hoefler 2 James C.R. Whittington † 1

sents.en: Ales Kubicek * 1 Andrea Caciolai * 1 Liangzu Peng * 1 Sukrit Sumant 1 Benjamin Hoover 1 Fraser Greenlee 1 Ruairidh M.
sents.zh: Ales Kubicek * 1 Andrea Caciolai * 1 梁祖鹏 * 1 Sukrit Sumant 1 Benjamin Hoover 1 Fraser Greenlee 1 Ruairidh M.

sents.en: Battleday 1 Radim Urban 2 Torsten Hoefler 2 James C.R. Whittington † 1
sents.zh: Battleday 1 Radim Urban 2 Torsten Hoefler 2 James C.R. Whittington † 1

paragraphs.en: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. Yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. We address this with Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. In LSA, keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space, and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key, making prefill, decode and training faster at long context. We propose two variants, Distilled-LSA (D-LSA), which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation, and Native-LSA (N-LSA), which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. On GLM-5.3-Flash ( Qwen-3.8-27B ) at 10M tokens, D-LSA speeds up one attention layer by 22.7 × 22.7\times ( 72.4 × 72.4\times ) in prefill and 4.6 × 4.6\times ( 42.5 × 42.5\times ) in decode over its original sparse attention (full attention), while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. N-LSA matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6 × 1.6\times per layer at 128k tokens. LSA offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式工作流正日益转向长程任务，例如开放式的科学工作，在这类任务中模型能从长上下文窗口中获益。 然而，在超长上下文（超过 100 万 token）下，完全注意力的开销高得令人望而却步。 一种有前景的方法是稀疏注意力，即由一个专门的索引器为注意力选取一部分键。 然而现有的索引方法要么在上下文规模上仍具有二次方复杂度的开销，要么在超长上下文尺度下损失精度。 我们通过潜在稀疏注意力（LSA）来解决这一问题，这是一种在超长上下文下仍能保持精度的高效注意力方法。 在 LSA 中，键在可学习的潜在空间中被分层聚类，查询对簇的层级结构进行打分而非对每个键逐一打分，从而在长上下文下加快预填充、解码和训练速度。 我们提出两个变体：蒸馏式 LSA（D-LSA），可通过蒸馏应用于预训练模型；以及原生 LSA（N-LSA），仅凭下一词元预测损失从头原生训练。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash（Qwen-3.8-27B）上处理 1000 万 token 时，相比其原有的稀疏注意力（完全注意力），D-LSA 在预填充阶段将单个注意力层加速 22.7 × 22.7\times（72.4 × 72.4\times），在解码阶段加速 4.6 × 4.6\times（42.5 × 42.5\times），同时在多种任务上保持相近的精度。 N-LSA 在 128k token 下达到与完全注意力相当的精度，每层训练加速 1.6 × 1.6\times。 LSA 为模型提供了实用且高效的注意力机制，使其能够从超长上下文中获益。

paragraphs.en: Large language models have moved from answering single requests to agentic workflows in long-horizon tasks, such as software engineering and open-ended scientific research ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . These tasks keep growing in length ( Kwa et al., 2025 ) , and models with longer context windows tend to score higher on them ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . In line with this trend, recent models extend their context windows to 1M tokens and beyond ( Gemini Team, 2024 ; MiniMax, 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型已经从回答单一请求发展到在长时程任务中执行智能体工作流，例如软件工程和开放式科学研究（Jimenez et al., 2024；Lu et al., 2026）。 这些任务的长度持续增长（Kwa et al., 2025），而上下文窗口更长的模型往往在这类任务上得分更高（Zhu et al., 2026）。 与这一趋势一致，近期的模型将其上下文窗口扩展到了 100 万 token 及以上（Gemini Team, 2024；MiniMax, 2025；DeepSeek-AI, 2026a；Qwen Team, 2026a）。

sents.en: Large language models have moved from answering single requests to agentic workflows in long-horizon tasks, such as software engineering and open-ended scientific research ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 大语言模型已经从回答单一请求发展到在长时程任务中执行智能体工作流，例如软件工程和开放式科学研究（Jimenez et al., 2024；Lu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: These tasks keep growing in length ( Kwa et al., 2025 ) , and models with longer context windows tend to score higher on them ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 这些任务的长度持续增长（Kwa et al., 2025），而上下文窗口更长的模型往往在这类任务上得分更高（Zhu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: In line with this trend, recent models extend their context windows to 1M tokens and beyond ( Gemini Team, 2024 ; MiniMax, 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 与这一趋势一致，近期的模型将其上下文窗口扩展到了 100 万 token 及以上（Gemini Team, 2024；MiniMax, 2025；DeepSeek-AI, 2026a；Qwen Team, 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: At this context size, attention dominates the cost, as its work grows with context ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Dao et al., 2022 ) . An established technique to reduce such costs is sparse attention ( Hoefler et al., 2021 ) , in which each query attends to only a subset of the keys, chosen by a fixed pattern ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) , by their content ( Kitaev et al., 2020 ; Roy et al., 2021 ) , or by a dedicated indexer ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) . Recent frontier models are increasingly adopting sparse attention, in which keys are selected using a dedicated indexer ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在这种上下文规模下，注意力机制占据了主要成本，因为其计算量随上下文增长（Vaswani 等，2017；Dao 等，2022）。 降低这类成本的一种成熟技术是稀疏注意力（Hoefler 等，2021），其中每个查询只关注一部分键，这些键可以按固定模式选取（Child 等，2019；Beltagy 等，2020；Zaheer 等，2020），也可以按其内容选取（Kitaev 等，2020；Roy 等，2021），或者通过专用索引器选取（Yuan 等，2025；DeepSeek-AI，2025）。 近期的前沿模型越来越多地采用稀疏注意力，即使用专用索引器来选取键（DeepSeek-AI，2025；Qwen Team，2026a）。

sents.en: At this context size, attention dominates the cost, as its work grows with context ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Dao et al., 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 在这种上下文规模下，注意力机制占据了主要成本，因为其计算量随上下文增长（Vaswani 等，2017；Dao 等，2022）。

sents.en: An established technique to reduce such costs is sparse attention ( Hoefler et al., 2021 ) , in which each query attends to only a subset of the keys, chosen by a fixed pattern ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) , by their content ( Kitaev et al., 2020 ; Roy et al., 2021 ) , or by a dedicated indexer ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 降低这类成本的一种成熟技术是稀疏注意力（Hoefler 等，2021），其中每个查询只关注一部分键，这些键可以按固定模式选取（Child 等，2019；Beltagy 等，2020；Zaheer 等，2020），也可以按其内容选取（Kitaev 等，2020；Roy 等，2021），或者通过专用索引器选取（Yuan 等，2025；DeepSeek-AI，2025）。

sents.en: Recent frontier models are increasingly adopting sparse attention, in which keys are selected using a dedicated indexer ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 近期的前沿模型越来越多地采用稀疏注意力，即使用专用索引器来选取键（DeepSeek-AI，2025；Qwen Team，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: However, current indexers still score every preceding key, or block of keys, for each query. This remains expensive (quadratic in prefill, linear in decode), and becomes a bottleneck at long context ( Zan et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . For example, at 10M tokens, 98% of the prefill time of a sparse attention layer is spent on indexing (Figure 2 ). The cost of sparse attention at ultra-long context is therefore dominated by the cost of finding the keys.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当前的索引器仍然会为每个查询对所有此前的键或键块进行评分。 这依然开销高昂（预填充阶段为二次复杂度，解码阶段为线性复杂度），并且成为长上下文场景下的瓶颈（Zan et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。 例如，在1000万token的规模下，稀疏注意力层的预填充时间有98%花费在索引上（图2）。 因此，在超长上下文中，稀疏注意力的成本主要由查找键的成本决定。

sents.en: However, current indexers still score every preceding key, or block of keys, for each query.
sents.zh: 然而，当前的索引器仍然会为每个查询对所有此前的键或键块进行评分。

sents.en: This remains expensive (quadratic in prefill, linear in decode), and becomes a bottleneck at long context ( Zan et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 这依然开销高昂（预填充阶段为二次复杂度，解码阶段为线性复杂度），并且成为长上下文场景下的瓶颈（Zan et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: For example, at 10M tokens, 98% of the prefill time of a sparse attention layer is spent on indexing (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 例如，在1000万token的规模下，稀疏注意力层的预填充时间有98%花费在索引上（图2）。

sents.en: The cost of sparse attention at ultra-long context is therefore dominated by the cost of finding the keys.
sents.zh: 因此，在超长上下文中，稀疏注意力的成本主要由查找键的成本决定。

paragraphs.en: To address this, we introduce Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), which clusters keys in a learned latent space and lets each query search the clusters instead of scoring every key. This can be done using only one level of clustering ( Flat ), or with a hierarchy of clusters ( Tree ), which makes the prefill subquadratic. Furthermore, we propose two trainable designs: D-LSA, which adds LSA to pre-trained models and only trains small projection matrices per layer (contribution #1) , and N-LSA, which trains LSA natively with the Next-Token Prediction (NTP) loss alone (contribution #2) . We evaluate state-of-the-art models ( Qwen-3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash ) beyond their advertised context, up to 10M tokens (contribution #3) , on RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , which is an established long-context benchmark, and PaperTrail, which we developed to test long-context scientific understanding by finding and connecting facts across unseen scientific papers (contribution #4) . Finally, we integrate LSA into SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) 1 1 1 github.com/Prefrontal-AI/sglang with context parallelism, provide GPU kernels for H200 and B300, and release the code 2 2 2 github.com/Prefrontal-AI/latent-sparse-attention with all training and inference details (contribution #5) . Figure 1 outlines our contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出潜在稀疏注意力（LSA），它在学习到的潜在空间中对键进行聚类，让每个查询搜索这些聚类，而不是对每个键都打分。 这可以只使用一层聚类（Flat），也可以使用聚类的层级结构（Tree），从而使预填充具有亚二次复杂度。 此外，我们提出两种可训练的设计：D-LSA，在预训练模型中加入 LSA，并且每层只训练小型投影矩阵（贡献 #1）；N-LSA，仅用下一词预测（NTP）损失原生地训练 LSA（贡献 #2）。 我们在超过模型官方宣称的上下文长度、最高达 1000 万 token 的条件下，在 RULER（Hsieh et al., 2024）（一个成熟的长上下文基准）以及 PaperTrail 上评估最先进的模型（Qwen-3.8-27B 和 GLM-5.3-Flash）（贡献 #3）；PaperTrail 是我们开发的基准，通过在未见过的科学论文中查找并关联事实来测试长上下文科学理解能力（贡献 #4）。 最后，我们将 LSA 集成到 SGLang（Zheng et al., 2024）1 1 1 github.com/Prefrontal-AI/sglang 中并支持上下文并行，为 H200 和 B300 提供 GPU 核函数，并发布代码 2 2 2 github.com/Prefrontal-AI/latent-sparse-attention，包含全部训练与推理细节（贡献 #5）。 图 1 概述了我们的贡献。

paragraphs.en: In full attention, every query attends to every preceding key. Prefilling a context of T T tokens therefore costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2}) , and decoding one token costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) . In sparse attention, the work is split between an indexer and the attention. For each query, the indexer selects which keys the attention attends to 3 3 3 In this view, full attention corresponds to an indexer that returns the indices of all preceding keys. . With a fixed budget of k k keys, the attention then costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ​ k ) \mathcal{O}(Tk) to prefill and 𝒪 ⁡ ( k ) \mathcal{O}(k) per decoded token. If the indexer selects the most relevant keys, this is sufficient to stay close to the accuracy of full attention (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 在完全注意力中，每个查询会关注所有前面的键。 因此预填充一个长度为 T T 个词元的上下文的代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2})，而解码一个词元的代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T)。 在稀疏注意力中，工作被拆分给索引器和注意力两部分。 对于每个查询，索引器会选择注意力要关注哪些键 3 3 3 从这个视角看，完全注意力对应于一个返回所有前面键的索引的索引器。 。 在键的预算固定为 k k 的情况下，注意力的预填充代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ​ k ) \mathcal{O}(Tk)，每个解码词元的代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( k ) \mathcal{O}(k)。 如果索引器选择最相关的键，这就足以保持接近完全注意力的准确率（附录 A ）。

sents.en: In full attention, every query attends to every preceding key.
sents.zh: 在完全注意力中，每个查询会关注所有前面的键。

sents.en: Prefilling a context of T T tokens therefore costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2}) , and decoding one token costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) .
sents.zh: 因此预填充一个长度为 T T 个词元的上下文的代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2})，而解码一个词元的代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T)。

sents.en: In sparse attention, the work is split between an indexer and the attention.
sents.zh: 在稀疏注意力中，工作被拆分给索引器和注意力两部分。

sents.en: For each query, the indexer selects which keys the attention attends to 3 3 3 In this view, full attention corresponds to an indexer that returns the indices of all preceding keys. .
sents.zh: 对于每个查询，索引器会选择注意力要关注哪些键 3 3 3 从这个视角看，完全注意力对应于一个返回所有前面键的索引的索引器。 。

sents.en: With a fixed budget of k k keys, the attention then costs 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ​ k ) \mathcal{O}(Tk) to prefill and 𝒪 ⁡ ( k ) \mathcal{O}(k) per decoded token.
sents.zh: 在键的预算固定为 k k 的情况下，注意力的预填充代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ​ k ) \mathcal{O}(Tk)，每个解码词元的代价为 𝒪 ⁡ ( k ) \mathcal{O}(k)。

sents.en: If the indexer selects the most relevant keys, this is sufficient to stay close to the accuracy of full attention (Appendix A ).
sents.zh: 如果索引器选择最相关的键，这就足以保持接近完全注意力的准确率（附录 A ）。

paragraphs.en: However, the indexer has a cost. Since it must score all preceding keys, it typically remains 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2}) in prefill and 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) in decode, though with reduced constant factors. This makes ultra-long context still prohibitively expensive. For example, at 10M tokens the indexer takes 98% of the prefill time of traditional sparse attention (Figure 2 ), and a ‘free’ indexer would make sparse attention a further 58 × 58\times faster in prefill and 8.9 × 8.9\times in decode.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，索引器是有代价的。 由于它必须对所有先前的键进行评分，它在预填充阶段通常仍保持 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2})，在解码阶段保持 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T)，只是常数因子有所降低。 这使得超长上下文仍然昂贵得令人望而却步。 例如，在1000万token时，索引器占传统稀疏注意力预填充时间的98%（图2），而一个“免费”的索引器将使稀疏注意力在预填充阶段再快 58 × 58\times，在解码阶段再快 8.9 × 8.9\times。

sents.en: This makes ultra-long context still prohibitively expensive.

sents.en: For example, at 10M tokens the indexer takes 98% of the prefill time of traditional sparse attention (Figure 2 ), and a ‘free’ indexer would make sparse attention a further 58 × 58\times faster in prefill and 8.9 × 8.9\times in decode.

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention methods can be categorised by their indexer designs and how they are trained.
paragraphs.zh: 稀疏注意力方法可以根据其索引器的设计以及它们的训练方式进行分类。

paragraphs.en: Token Sparse Attention. For each query, a lightweight indexer (fewer heads, smaller dimension, lower precision) scores every preceding key and selects which to attend to.
paragraphs.zh: Token 稀疏注意力。 对于每个查询，一个轻量级索引器（更少的头、更小的维度、更低的精度）会对之前所有的键进行打分，并选出需要注意的对象。

sents.en: Token Sparse Attention.
sents.zh: Token 稀疏注意力。

sents.en: For each query, a lightweight indexer (fewer heads, smaller dimension, lower precision) scores every preceding key and selects which to attend to.
sents.zh: 对于每个查询，一个轻量级索引器（更少的头、更小的维度、更低的精度）会对之前所有的键进行打分，并选出需要注意的对象。

paragraphs.en: Block Sparse Attention. Consecutive keys are grouped into blocks, and each query scores blocks instead of every key. All keys of the selected blocks are sent to the attention.
paragraphs.zh: 块稀疏注意力。 连续的键被分组成块，每个查询对块进行打分，而不是对每个键打分。 被选中块的所有键都会被送入注意力机制。

sents.en: Block Sparse Attention.
sents.zh: 块稀疏注意力。

sents.en: Consecutive keys are grouped into blocks, and each query scores blocks instead of every key.
sents.zh: 连续的键被分组成块，每个查询对块进行打分，而不是对每个键打分。

sents.en: All keys of the selected blocks are sent to the attention.
sents.zh: 被选中块的所有键都会被送入注意力机制。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Sparse Attention. Keys are clustered by similarity rather than position, and each query scores one centroid per cluster. All keys of the selected clusters are sent to the attention.
paragraphs.zh: 语义稀疏注意力。 键（keys）按相似性而非位置进行聚类，每个查询（query）对每个簇的一个质心进行打分。 被选中簇的所有键（keys）都会被送入注意力机制。

sents.en: Semantic Sparse Attention.
sents.zh: 语义稀疏注意力。

sents.en: Keys are clustered by similarity rather than position, and each query scores one centroid per cluster.
sents.zh: 键（keys）按相似性而非位置进行聚类，每个查询（query）对每个簇的一个质心进行打分。

sents.en: All keys of the selected clusters are sent to the attention.
sents.zh: 被选中簇的所有键（keys）都会被送入注意力机制。

paragraphs.en: For the last two categories, a query can search the groups in three ways. Flat search scores every group directly, which is 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) work per query. Fixed search adds a shallow hierarchy and refines from coarse to fine groups, which is also 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) per query. Tree search descends a deeper hierarchy and expands only the groups it keeps at each level, which is 𝒪 ⁡ ( log ⁡ T ) \mathcal{O}(\log T) per query.
paragraphs.zh: 对于后两类，查询可以通过三种方式搜索分组。 平面搜索直接对每个分组打分，每次查询的计算量为 𝒪(T)。 固定搜索增加一个浅层层次结构，并从粗粒度分组逐步细化到细粒度分组，每次查询的计算量同样为 𝒪(T)。 树搜索沿更深的层次结构下行，且在每一层只展开其保留的分组，每次查询的计算量为 𝒪(log T)。

sents.en: For the last two categories, a query can search the groups in three ways.
sents.zh: 对于后两类，查询可以通过三种方式搜索分组。

sents.en: Flat search scores every group directly, which is 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) work per query.
sents.zh: 平面搜索直接对每个分组打分，每次查询的计算量为 𝒪(T)。

sents.en: Fixed search adds a shallow hierarchy and refines from coarse to fine groups, which is also 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{O}(T) per query.
sents.zh: 固定搜索增加一个浅层层次结构，并从粗粒度分组逐步细化到细粒度分组，每次查询的计算量同样为 𝒪(T)。

sents.en: Tree search descends a deeper hierarchy and expands only the groups it keeps at each level, which is 𝒪 ⁡ ( log ⁡ T ) \mathcal{O}(\log T) per query.
sents.zh: 树搜索沿更深的层次结构下行，且在每一层只展开其保留的分组，每次查询的计算量为 𝒪(log T)。

paragraphs.en: An indexer can be training-free, distilled from a pre-trained model, or trained natively on the NTP loss alone.
paragraphs.zh: 索引器可以是无需训练的、从预训练模型蒸馏而来的，或仅基于 NTP 损失原生训练得到的。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 provides an overview of the existing work on sparse attention, as categorised above. We focus on methods that keep the whole KV cache and select keys per query, unlike fixed sparse patterns ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) and KV cache eviction techniques ( Zhang et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 表1按上述分类对稀疏注意力的现有工作进行了概述。 我们关注那些保留完整KV缓存并针对每个查询选择键的方法，这与固定稀疏模式（Child et al., 2019; Beltagy et al., 2020; Zaheer et al., 2020）以及KV缓存驱逐技术（Zhang et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2024; Xiao et al., 2024b）不同。

sents.en: Table 1 provides an overview of the existing work on sparse attention, as categorised above.
sents.zh: 表1按上述分类对稀疏注意力的现有工作进行了概述。

sents.en: We focus on methods that keep the whole KV cache and select keys per query, unlike fixed sparse patterns ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) and KV cache eviction techniques ( Zhang et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024b ) .
sents.zh: 我们关注那些保留完整KV缓存并针对每个查询选择键的方法，这与固定稀疏模式（Child et al., 2019; Beltagy et al., 2020; Zaheer et al., 2020）以及KV缓存驱逐技术（Zhang et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2024; Xiao et al., 2024b）不同。

paragraphs.en: Among distillation methods, DSA ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) and MiniMax SA ( Lai et al., 2026 ) first distil the indexer and then continue training the full model under sparse attention. Alternatively, SeerAttention ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) distils a gate over pooled blocks and HashAttention ( Desai et al., 2025 ) learns binary codes of queries and keys, both with the model frozen. As the context grows, the indexer itself becomes the bottleneck ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Zan et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2026 ) . To reduce its cost, CSA ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) , QSA ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , and GLM-5.3-Flash SA ( Z.ai, 2026 ) compress every four keys into one before scoring them. HISA ( Xu et al., 2026 ) and LongCat LSA ( Zan et al., 2026 ) score blocks first and then only the keys inside the selected blocks. IndexCache ( Bai et al., 2026 ) , LongCat LSA and DeepSeek-V4.1 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026b ) reuse the selection of one layer in the following layers. Each improvement divides the cost of the indexer by a constant, and its work per query therefore still grows linearly with the context.
paragraphs.zh: 在蒸馏方法中，DSA（DeepSeek-AI, 2025）和 MiniMax SA（Lai et al., 2026）先对索引器进行蒸馏，然后在稀疏注意力下继续训练完整模型。 另一种方式是，SeerAttention（Gao et al., 2025；Gao et al., 2026）对池化后的块蒸馏一个门控，HashAttention（Desai et al., 2025）学习查询和键的二进制编码，两者都在模型冻结的情况下进行。 随着上下文增长，索引器本身成为瓶颈（Xu et al., 2026；Zan et al., 2026；Bai et al., 2026）。 为了降低其成本，CSA（DeepSeek-AI, 2026a）、QSA（Qwen Team, 2026a）和 GLM-5.3-Flash SA（Z.ai, 2026）在打分之前将每四个键压缩为一个。 HISA（Xu et al., 2026）和 LongCat LSA（Zan et al., 2026）先对块打分，然后只对被选中块内的键进行打分。 IndexCache（Bai et al., 2026）、LongCat LSA 和 DeepSeek-V4.1（DeepSeek-AI, 2026b）将某一层的选择结果在后续层中复用。 每项改进都将索引器的成本除以一个常数，因此其每个查询的工作量仍然随上下文线性增长。

paragraphs.en: NSA ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) and MoBA ( Lu et al., 2025 ) instead pre-train the model with sparse attention from scratch, such that the indexer learns from the NTP loss alone. NSA scores each block by a learned compressed key, and MoBA by the mean of its keys. InfLLM-V2 ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) and SSA ( Mao et al., 2026a ) bring such block selection to existing dense models by fine-tuning. HSA ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Leng et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026a ) and HSA-UltraLong ( Hu et al., 2026b ) also weight the output of each block by its score, such that the loss trains the scores directly. All of these methods still scan every block. PISA ( Tang et al., 2026 ) replaces this scan with a tree, but evaluates accuracy only at small scale (up to 16k tokens).
paragraphs.zh: NSA（Yuan 等，2025）和 MoBA（Lu 等，2025）则从零开始以稀疏注意力对模型进行预训练，使得索引器仅从 NTP 损失中学习。 NSA 通过学习到的压缩键为每个块打分，MoBA 则通过其键的均值打分。 InfLLM-V2（Zhao 等，2026）和 SSA（Mao 等，2026a）通过微调将这种块选择引入现有的稠密模型。 HSA（Hu 等，2025；Leng 等，2026；Hu 等，2026a）和 HSA-UltraLong（Hu 等，2026b）还按分数对每个块的输出加权，使得损失直接训练分数。 所有这些方法仍然要扫描每一个块。 PISA（Tang 等，2026）用一棵树取代了这种扫描，但仅在较小规模（最多 16k 个 token）上评估准确率。

paragraphs.en: At the other end, Quest ( Tang et al., 2024 ) , InfLLM ( Xiao et al., 2024a ) and MInference ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) select blocks based on simple summaries of their keys without any training. HiP ( Lee et al., 2025a ) searches the blocks with a tree, and its successor InfiniteHiP ( Lee et al., 2025b ) with three fixed stages. BLASST ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) instead skips blocks directly inside the attention kernel, without a dedicated indexer. Most of these methods summarise blocks of consecutive keys, which may hide a single relevant key ( Xiao et al., 2024a ; Hu et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在另一端，Quest（Tang et al., 2024）、InfLLM（Xiao et al., 2024a）和 MInference（Jiang et al., 2024）基于对键的简单摘要来选择块，且无需任何训练。 HiP（Lee et al., 2025a）使用树来搜索块，其后续工作 InfiniteHiP（Lee et al., 2025b）则使用三个固定阶段。 BLASST（Yuan et al., 2026）则直接在注意力内核内部跳过块，而不使用专门的索引器。 这些方法大多对连续键组成的块进行摘要，这可能会隐藏单个相关的键（Xiao et al., 2024a；Hu et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Closest to LSA are methods that organise the keys by semantic content rather than by position. A few early works train at short context, with Reformer ( Kitaev et al., 2020 ) hashing keys into buckets, Routing Transformer ( Roy et al., 2021 ) learning k-means centroids, and Treeformer ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) routing each query down a learned tree. Most other works here only operate at inference time: ClusterKV ( Liu et al., 2025b ) and RetroInfer ( Chen et al., 2026 ) cluster the keys during prefill and score every centroid at decode (flat search), Squeezed Attention ( Hooper et al., 2025b ) , Multipole Attention ( Hooper et al., 2025a ) and LycheeCluster ( Li et al., 2026 ) search two levels (fixed search), and IceCache ( Mao et al., 2026b ) descends a tree of keys (tree search), while RetrievalAttention ( Liu et al., 2025a ) links the keys in a nearest-neighbour graph. All of these inference methods are training-free, only Squeezed Attention speeds up prefill, and only partially, and none are evaluated at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens).
paragraphs.zh: 与 LSA 最接近的是那些按键的语义内容而非按键的位置来组织键的方法。 少数早期工作在短上下文中训练：Reformer（Kitaev et al., 2020）将键哈希到桶中，Routing Transformer（Roy et al., 2021）学习 k-means 质心，Treeformer（Madaan et al., 2023）将每个智能体查询沿一棵学习到的树进行路由。 这里的其他大多数工作仅在推理阶段起作用：ClusterKV（Liu et al., 2025b）和 RetroInfer（Chen et al., 2026）在预填充阶段对键进行聚类，并在解码时对每个质心打分（扁平搜索）；Squeezed Attention（Hooper et al., 2025b）、Multipole Attention（Hooper et al., 2025a）和 LycheeCluster（Li et al., 2026）进行两级搜索（固定搜索）；IceCache（Mao et al., 2026b）沿一棵键树向下搜索（树搜索）；而 RetrievalAttention（Liu et al., 2025a）则将键组织成最近邻图。 所有这些推理方法都是免训练的，只有 Squeezed Attention 能加速预填充且只是部分加速，并且没有任何一种在超长上下文（超过 100 万 token）下进行过评估。

sents.en: Closest to LSA are methods that organise the keys by semantic content rather than by position.
sents.zh: 与 LSA 最接近的是那些按键的语义内容而非按键的位置来组织键的方法。

sents.en: A few early works train at short context, with Reformer ( Kitaev et al., 2020 ) hashing keys into buckets, Routing Transformer ( Roy et al., 2021 ) learning k-means centroids, and Treeformer ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) routing each query down a learned tree.

paragraphs.en: LSA is a sparse attention layer for ultra-long context. It clusters keys by content, in a space that is learned: through index projections in D-LSA, and through the attention’s own keys in N-LSA. LSA can replace the attention of a pre-trained layer by distillation (D-LSA) or be trained natively with the model (N-LSA).
paragraphs.zh: LSA 是一种用于超长上下文的稀疏注意力层。 它在一个可学习的空间中按内容对键进行聚类：在 D-LSA 中通过索引投影实现，在 N-LSA 中通过注意力自身的键实现。 LSA 可以通过蒸馏（D-LSA）替换预训练层的注意力，也可以随模型进行原生训练（N-LSA）。

sents.en: LSA is a sparse attention layer for ultra-long context.
sents.zh: LSA 是一种用于超长上下文的稀疏注意力层。

sents.en: It clusters keys by content, in a space that is learned: through index projections in D-LSA, and through the attention’s own keys in N-LSA.
sents.zh: 它在一个可学习的空间中按内容对键进行聚类：在 D-LSA 中通过索引投影实现，在 N-LSA 中通过注意力自身的键实现。

sents.en: LSA can replace the attention of a pre-trained layer by distillation (D-LSA) or be trained natively with the model (N-LSA).
sents.zh: LSA 可以通过蒸馏（D-LSA）替换预训练层的注意力，也可以随模型进行原生训练（N-LSA）。

paragraphs.en: In both settings, the indices for the attention are selected from the keys and queries by the same process. We first describe this process, numbered as in Figure 3 , which consists of semantic clustering of the index keys k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , and the search with the index queries q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} so that each query selects its keys. We then describe the specifics of D-LSA and N-LSA.
paragraphs.zh: 在这两种设置中，注意力的索引都通过相同的过程从键和查询中选取。 我们首先描述这一过程（编号如图 3 所示），该过程包括对索引键 k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 进行语义聚类，以及使用索引查询 q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 进行搜索，使得每个查询选中自己的键。 然后我们描述 D-LSA 和 N-LSA 的具体细节。

sents.zh: 在这两种设置中，注意力的索引都通过相同的过程从键和查询中选取。

paragraphs.en: Pooling. Consecutive keys are then compressed, as in CSA ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) , QSA ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and GLM-5.3-Flash SA ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , to improve computational efficiency. Here, every n pool n_{\mathrm{pool}} consecutive index keys are summed into one pool key k pool ( idx ) k_{\mathrm{pool}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , so that clustering runs over T / n pool T/n_{\mathrm{pool}} pool keys rather than T T keys.
paragraphs.zh: 池化。 随后，如同 CSA（DeepSeek-AI, 2026a）、QSA（Qwen Team, 2026a）以及 GLM-5.3-Flash SA（Z.ai, 2026）中的做法，对连续的键进行压缩，以提升计算效率。 在此，每 n_{\mathrm{pool}} 个连续的索引键被求和为一个池键 k_{\mathrm{pool}}^{(\mathrm{idx})}，使得聚类在 T/n_{\mathrm{pool}} 个池键上进行，而非在 T 个键上进行。

sents.en: Pooling.
sents.zh: 池化。

sents.en: Consecutive keys are then compressed, as in CSA ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) , QSA ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and GLM-5.3-Flash SA ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , to improve computational efficiency.
sents.zh: 随后，如同 CSA（DeepSeek-AI, 2026a）、QSA（Qwen Team, 2026a）以及 GLM-5.3-Flash SA（Z.ai, 2026）中的做法，对连续的键进行压缩，以提升计算效率。

sents.en: Here, every n pool n_{\mathrm{pool}} consecutive index keys are summed into one pool key k pool ( idx ) k_{\mathrm{pool}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , so that clustering runs over T / n pool T/n_{\mathrm{pool}} pool keys rather than T T keys.
sents.zh: 在此，每 n_{\mathrm{pool}} 个连续的索引键被求和为一个池键 k_{\mathrm{pool}}^{(\mathrm{idx})}，使得聚类在 T/n_{\mathrm{pool}} 个池键上进行，而非在 T 个键上进行。

paragraphs.en: Clustering. Keys are clustered in cluster blocks of n cluster n_{\mathrm{cluster}} consecutive keys. Once a cluster block contains all its keys, its pool keys are clustered bottom up with Ward’s method ( Ward, 1963 ) into m m buckets (Algorithm 1 in Appendix B ). Each pool key starts as a bucket of its own, and each bucket keeps the sum of its keys, whose normalisation is its centroid c b c_{b} . In every round, all pairs of buckets that are each other’s cheapest merge are merged in parallel. The cost of a merge is how much it increases the keys’ total squared distance from their centroid (Ward’s criterion). Merging stops once there are m = n cluster / n ¯ b m=n_{\mathrm{cluster}}/\bar{n}_{b} buckets, where n ¯ b \bar{n}_{b} is the average number of keys per bucket, such that every cluster block holds the same number of buckets. A merge is skipped if the merged bucket would hold more than n b max n_{b}^{\mathrm{max}} keys.
paragraphs.zh: 聚类。 密钥按每 n_{\mathrm{cluster}} 个连续密钥组成的聚类块进行聚类。 一旦某个聚类块包含其全部密钥，其池密钥会用 Ward 方法（Ward, 1963）自底向上聚类为 m 个桶（见附录 B 中的算法 1）。 每个池密钥初始时自成 一个桶，每个桶保存其密钥之和，其归一化即为该桶的质心 c_{b}。 在每一轮中，所有互为最廉价合并对象的桶对会被并行合并。 一次合并的代价是它使密钥到其质心的总平方距离增加的量（Ward 准则）。 当剩下 m=n_{\mathrm{cluster}}/\bar{n}_{b} 个桶时合并停止，其中 \bar{n}_{b} 是每个桶的平均密钥数，从而使每个聚类块拥有相同数量的桶。 若合并后的桶将包含超过 n_{b}^{\mathrm{max}} 个密钥，则跳过该次合并。

sents.en: Clustering.
sents.zh: 聚类。

sents.en: Keys are clustered in cluster blocks of n cluster n_{\mathrm{cluster}} consecutive keys.
sents.zh: 密钥按每 n_{\mathrm{cluster}} 个连续密钥组成的聚类块进行聚类。

sents.zh: 每个池密钥初始时自成 一个桶，每个桶保存其密钥之和，其归一化即为该桶的质心 c_{b}。

sents.en: In every round, all pairs of buckets that are each other’s cheapest merge are merged in parallel.
sents.zh: 在每一轮中，所有互为最廉价合并对象的桶对会被并行合并。

sents.en: The cost of a merge is how much it increases the keys’ total squared distance from their centroid (Ward’s criterion).
sents.zh: 一次合并的代价是它使密钥到其质心的总平方距离增加的量（Ward 准则）。

sents.en: Merging stops once there are m = n cluster / n ¯ b m=n_{\mathrm{cluster}}/\bar{n}_{b} buckets, where n ¯ b \bar{n}_{b} is the average number of keys per bucket, such that every cluster block holds the same number of buckets.
sents.zh: 当剩下 m=n_{\mathrm{cluster}}/\bar{n}_{b} 个桶时合并停止，其中 \bar{n}_{b} 是每个桶的平均密钥数，从而使每个聚类块拥有相同数量的桶。

sents.en: A merge is skipped if the merged bucket would hold more than n b max n_{b}^{\mathrm{max}} keys.
sents.zh: 若合并后的桶将包含超过 n_{b}^{\mathrm{max}} 个密钥，则跳过该次合并。

paragraphs.en: Bucket cache. The bucket cache B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} stores the centroid c b c_{b} of every bucket and an index table of the positions of its keys. This is so later selected buckets can ‘expand’ into their key indices. With one centroid per n ¯ b \bar{n}_{b} keys, it corresponds to a small fraction of the KV cache.
paragraphs.zh: 桶缓存。 桶缓存 B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 存储每个桶的质心 c b c_{b} 以及其键的位置索引表。 这样一来，后续被选中的桶可以「展开」为其键的索引。 由于每 n ¯ b \bar{n}_{b} 个键才对应一个质心，它只占 KV 缓存的一小部分。

sents.en: Bucket cache.
sents.zh: 桶缓存。

sents.en: The bucket cache B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} stores the centroid c b c_{b} of every bucket and an index table of the positions of its keys.

paragraphs.en: Once a cluster block is clustered, its buckets never change. In the Tree variant, this clustering process is repeated to group the buckets into multiple levels of a hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦簇块被聚簇，其桶就永远不会改变。 在树变体中，这一聚簇过程会重复进行，将桶分组为层次结构的多个层级。

sents.en: Once a cluster block is clustered, its buckets never change.
sents.zh: 一旦簇块被聚簇，其桶就永远不会改变。

sents.en: In the Tree variant, this clustering process is repeated to group the buckets into multiple levels of a hierarchy.

paragraphs.en: We now describe how the top- k k key indices are extracted for each query, and then submitted to attention. We first describe the process for Flat , in which there is only one level of buckets, and then discuss Tree .
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在描述如何为每个查询提取top- k k关键索引，然后将其提交给注意力机制。 我们首先描述Flat的过程，其中只有一层桶，然后讨论Tree。

sents.en: We now describe how the top- k k key indices are extracted for each query, and then submitted to attention.
sents.zh: 我们现在描述如何为每个查询提取top- k k关键索引，然后将其提交给注意力机制。

sents.en: We first describe the process for Flat , in which there is only one level of buckets, and then discuss Tree .
sents.zh: 我们首先描述Flat的过程，其中只有一层桶，然后讨论Tree。

paragraphs.en: Query normalisation. Each index query q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} is first L2 normalised: q i ( idx ) ← q i ( idx ) ∥ q i ( idx ) ∥ q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\leftarrow\frac{q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}}{\lVert q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\rVert}
paragraphs.zh: 查询归一化。 每个索引查询 q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 首先进行 L2 归一化：q i ( idx ) ← q i ( idx ) ∥ q i ( idx ) ∥ q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\leftarrow\frac{q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}}{\lVert q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\rVert}

sents.en: Query normalisation.
sents.zh: 查询归一化。

sents.en: Each index query q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} is first L2 normalised: q i ( idx ) ← q i ( idx ) ∥ q i ( idx ) ∥ q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\leftarrow\frac{q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}}{\lVert q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\rVert}
sents.zh: 每个索引查询 q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 首先进行 L2 归一化：q i ( idx ) ← q i ( idx ) ∥ q i ( idx ) ∥ q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\leftarrow\frac{q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}}{\lVert q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\rVert}

paragraphs.en: Scoring. The index query scores the unit-norm centroid of every bucket in the cluster blocks before its own via s i , b = c b ⋅ q i ( idx ) s_{i,b}=c_{b}\cdot q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , which compares buckets of any size on one scale, and selects the top- p p buckets. Its own cluster block is not clustered yet, and its keys are covered by the window instead.
paragraphs.zh: 打分。 索引查询通过 s i , b = c b ⋅ q i ( idx ) s_{i,b}=c_{b}\cdot q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 对位于其自身之前的聚类块中每个桶的单位范数质心进行打分，该式在统一尺度上比较任意大小的桶，并选出得分最高的前 p p 个桶。 其自身的聚类块尚未被聚类，其键改由窗口覆盖。

sents.en: Scoring.
sents.zh: 打分。

sents.en: The index query scores the unit-norm centroid of every bucket in the cluster blocks before its own via s i , b = c b ⋅ q i ( idx ) s_{i,b}=c_{b}\cdot q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , which compares buckets of any size on one scale, and selects the top- p p buckets.
sents.zh: 索引查询通过 s i , b = c b ⋅ q i ( idx ) s_{i,b}=c_{b}\cdot q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 对位于其自身之前的聚类块中每个桶的单位范数质心进行打分，该式在统一尺度上比较任意大小的桶，并选出得分最高的前 p p 个桶。

sents.en: Its own cluster block is not clustered yet, and its keys are covered by the window instead.
sents.zh: 其自身的聚类块尚未被聚类，其键改由窗口覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Expansion. The selected p p buckets are expanded into their keys, best first, until k k ‘long-range’ keys are selected. As every bucket holds at least n pool n_{\mathrm{pool}} keys, p p is chosen such that p ⋅ n pool ≥ k p\cdot n_{\mathrm{pool}}\geq k , and so expansion always fills k k keys.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展。 被选中的 p p 个桶会被逐步展开为其中的键，按最优优先的顺序，直到选出 k k 个「长程」键。 由于每个桶至少持有 n pool n_{\mathrm{pool}} 个键，因此选择 p p 使得 p ⋅ n pool ≥ k p\cdot n_{\mathrm{pool}}\geq k ，所以扩展总是能填满 k k 个键。

sents.en: Expansion.
sents.zh: 扩展。

sents.en: The selected p p buckets are expanded into their keys, best first, until k k ‘long-range’ keys are selected.
sents.zh: 被选中的 p p 个桶会被逐步展开为其中的键，按最优优先的顺序，直到选出 k k 个「长程」键。

sents.en: As every bucket holds at least n pool n_{\mathrm{pool}} keys, p p is chosen such that p ⋅ n pool ≥ k p\cdot n_{\mathrm{pool}}\geq k , and so expansion always fills k k keys.
sents.zh: 由于每个桶至少持有 n pool n_{\mathrm{pool}} 个键，因此选择 p p 使得 p ⋅ n pool ≥ k p\cdot n_{\mathrm{pool}}\geq k ，所以扩展总是能填满 k k 个键。

paragraphs.en: Besides the k k long-range keys, every query attends to n sink n_{\mathrm{sink}} sink keys ( Xiao et al., 2024b ) and the n w n_{w} most recent keys (window). A key of a selected bucket that falls in the sink or the window is already attended to, and the expansion moves on to the next key instead. We set the window to one cluster block, n w = n cluster n_{w}=n_{\mathrm{cluster}} , so that the window covers every key not yet clustered. This gives each query i i a set J i J_{i} of at most n sink + k + n w n_{\mathrm{sink}}+k+n_{w} key indices.
paragraphs.zh: 除了 k k 个长程键之外，每个查询还会关注 n sink n_{\mathrm{sink}} 个汇聚键（Xiao et al., 2024b）以及最近邻的 n w n_{w} 个键（窗口）。 被选中桶中落入汇聚或窗口内的键已经被关注过了，此时扩展会跳到下一个键。 我们将窗口设置为一个聚类块，即 n w = n cluster n_{w}=n_{\mathrm{cluster}}，这样窗口可以覆盖所有尚未被聚类的键。 这为每个查询 i i 提供了一个最多包含 n sink + k + n w n_{\mathrm{sink}}+k+n_{w} 个键索引的集合 J i J_{i}。

sents.en: Besides the k k long-range keys, every query attends to n sink n_{\mathrm{sink}} sink keys ( Xiao et al., 2024b ) and the n w n_{w} most recent keys (window).
sents.zh: 除了 k k 个长程键之外，每个查询还会关注 n sink n_{\mathrm{sink}} 个汇聚键（Xiao et al., 2024b）以及最近邻的 n w n_{w} 个键（窗口）。

sents.en: A key of a selected bucket that falls in the sink or the window is already attended to, and the expansion moves on to the next key instead.
sents.zh: 被选中桶中落入汇聚或窗口内的键已经被关注过了，此时扩展会跳到下一个键。

sents.en: We set the window to one cluster block, n w = n cluster n_{w}=n_{\mathrm{cluster}} , so that the window covers every key not yet clustered.
sents.zh: 我们将窗口设置为一个聚类块，即 n w = n cluster n_{w}=n_{\mathrm{cluster}}，这样窗口可以覆盖所有尚未被聚类的键。

sents.en: This gives each query i i a set J i J_{i} of at most n sink + k + n w n_{\mathrm{sink}}+k+n_{w} key indices.
sents.zh: 这为每个查询 i i 提供了一个最多包含 n sink + k + n w n_{\mathrm{sink}}+k+n_{w} 个键索引的集合 J i J_{i}。

paragraphs.en: Attention. Attention is then computed only over the keys indexed by J i J_{i} . A single J i J_{i} is shared across all query heads.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力。 注意力随后仅对由 J i J_{i} 索引的键进行计算。 单个 J i J_{i} 在所有查询头之间共享。

sents.zh: 注意力。

paragraphs.en: Tree search arranges the buckets into a hierarchy (Figure 3 , right). Level 0 holds the buckets, and each higher level ℓ ≥ 1 \ell\geq 1 holds buckets we term ‘node buckets’, each made of n b , ℓ n_{b,\ell} buckets of the level below, with a centroid over all the keys it contains. As at level 0, buckets are merged one cluster block at a time. Buckets that are not merged yet are defined as open. Once a level holds n cluster , ℓ n_{\mathrm{cluster},\ell} open buckets, they are merged into node buckets as in Algorithm 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 树搜索将桶组织成一个层次结构（图 3，右）。 第 0 层存放桶，每个更高层 ℓ ≥ 1 存放我们称为「节点桶」的桶，每个节点桶由下一层的 n_{b,ℓ} 个桶组成，并对其包含的所有键计算一个质心。 与第 0 层一样，桶一次合并一个聚类块。 尚未被合并的桶被定义为开放状态。 一旦某一层拥有 n_{cluster,ℓ} 个开放桶，就按照算法 1 将它们合并为节点桶。

paragraphs.en: Beam search is used to select the buckets through the hierarchy (Algorithm 2 in Appendix B ). On each level, the query is scored against the centroids of the candidate node buckets, and the best p ℓ p_{\ell} are kept. The candidates on the level below are the children of the kept node buckets and the open buckets of that level. At level 0, the top- p p buckets are selected, as in the flat search. With a constant beam per level, a query scores 𝒪 ⁡ ( log ⁡ T ) \mathcal{O}(\log T) centroids, which makes the prefill of the indexer subquadratic, 𝒪 ⁡ ( T ​ log ⁡ T ) \mathcal{O}(T\log T) , where the flat search is quadratic.
paragraphs.zh: 束搜索（beam search）用于沿层级结构选择桶（见附录 B 中的算法 2）。 在每一层上，将查询与候选节点桶的质心进行打分，并保留最佳的 p_{\ell} 个。 下一层的候选对象是保留的节点桶的子节点以及该层的开放桶。 在第 0 层，选出前 p 个桶，与扁平搜索相同。 每层使用恒定的束宽时，一个查询只需对 𝒪(\log T) 个质心打分，这使得索引器的预填充是亚二次的，即 𝒪(T\log T)，而扁平搜索是二次的。

paragraphs.en: The query heads are summed such that one index query serves every head, which yields the single index list J i J_{i} per query. paragraphs.en: Parallelism. We integrate LSA into SGLang with support for tensor, expert, and pipeline parallelism, and for context parallelism in both prefill and decode. Context parallelism splits the KV cache across ranks by token, but LSA replicates its bucket cache on every rank. Every rank thus builds the same index and selects the same index list. The ranks only exchange the index keys of the newest tokens. This design choice trades memory for communication. At 10M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash with context parallelism over 8 GPUs, each rank holds a 1.25 GiB share of the 10 GiB KV cache of a layer and the full 246 MiB bucket cache.
paragraphs.zh: 并行性。 我们将LSA集成到SGLang中，支持张量并行、专家并行、流水线并行，以及预填充和解码阶段的上下文并行。 上下文并行按token将KV缓存切分到各个rank上，但LSA在每个rank上都复制其桶缓存。 因此每个rank都会构建相同的索引并选择相同的索引列表。 各rank之间只交换最新token的索引键。 这一设计选择以内存换取通信。 在GLM-5.3-Flash上使用跨8张GPU的上下文并行处理1000万token时，每个rank持有一个层级100亿（10 GiB）KV缓存中1.25 GiB的份额，以及完整的246 MiB桶缓存。

paragraphs.en: N-LSA (Figure 4 ) trains LSA natively with the model, using only the NTP loss. As the model learns with the selection from the start, we cluster the keys of the attention itself, without dedicated index projections. We use a single key-value head, such that one key per token serves every query head, and score each bucket by the best similarity any query head gives its centroid:
paragraphs.zh: N-LSA（图4）使用模型原生方式训练LSA，仅使用NTP损失。 由于模型从一开始就结合选择机制进行学习，我们对注意力本身的键进行聚类，而无需专门的索引投影。 我们使用单一的键值头，使得每个标记的一个键服务于所有查询头，并根据任意查询头与质心的最佳相似度对每个桶进行评分：

sents.zh: 其中 q ^ i , h \hat{q}_{i,h} 是头 h h 的归一化查询。

sents.en: We stop the gradient through the selection, and the NTP loss trains the attention projections only through the keys each query attends to, the selected keys plus the sink and the window.
sents.zh: 我们在选择过程中停止梯度，NTP 损失仅通过每个查询所关注的键（即选中的键加上 sink 和窗口）来训练注意力投影。

sents.en: N-LSA therefore adds no parameters to the model and needs no teacher, no index projections and no auxiliary loss.
sents.zh: 因此，N-LSA 不会给模型增加任何参数，也不需要教师、索引投影或辅助损失。

paragraphs.en: The attention layers of N-LSA use no positional encoding, as is becoming more common in hybrid models, and RoPE could be supported by clustering only the RoPE-free part of the keys, as D-LSA does on Qwen-3.8-27B .
paragraphs.zh: N-LSA 的注意力层不使用位置编码，这在混合模型中正变得越来越普遍；RoPE 也可以通过仅对键中不含 RoPE 的部分进行聚类来支持，正如 D-LSA 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上所做的那样。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe the models, the methods we compare, and their settings. Then, we evaluate the accuracy of D-LSA up to 10M tokens, and its performance per attention layer and end to end. Finally, we show that N-LSA can be trained natively at an accuracy close to full attention.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍模型、所比较的方法及其设置。 然后，我们评估 D-LSA 在最多 1000 万 token 下的准确率，以及其逐注意力层和端到端的性能。 最后，我们表明 N-LSA 可以以接近全注意力准确率的方式原生训练。

sents.en: In this section, we describe the models, the methods we compare, and their settings.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍模型、所比较的方法及其设置。

sents.en: Then, we evaluate the accuracy of D-LSA up to 10M tokens, and its performance per attention layer and end to end.
sents.zh: 然后，我们评估 D-LSA 在最多 1000 万 token 下的准确率，以及其逐注意力层和端到端的性能。

sents.en: Finally, we show that N-LSA can be trained natively at an accuracy close to full attention.
sents.zh: 最后，我们表明 N-LSA 可以以接近全注意力准确率的方式原生训练。

paragraphs.en: Models. D-LSA aims to keep the accuracy of a model while making its attention significantly cheaper. We compare each model with D-LSA against its baseline attention, in accuracy and in performance. We demonstrate D-LSA on both a model with full attention ( Qwen-3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ; Qwen Team, 2026c ) ) and one with sparse attention ( GLM-5.3-Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) ). On Qwen-3.8-27B , we also replace the attention with block sparse attention, inspired by QSA ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , as a second sparse baseline. We also compare flat to tree search where possible.

paragraphs.en: Full Attention : every query attends to every preceding key, the baseline attention of Qwen-3.8-27B .
paragraphs.zh: 全注意力（Full Attention）：每个 query 都关注其之前的所有 key，这是 Qwen-3.8-27B 的基线注意力机制。

paragraphs.en: Block Sparse Attention (Flat) : sparse attention whose indexer scores every block of four consecutive keys, as in QSA ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and GLM-5.3-Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 块稀疏注意力（Flat）：一种稀疏注意力，其索引器对每四个连续键组成的块进行评分，如 QSA（Qwen Team, 2026a）和 GLM-5.3-Flash（Z.ai, 2026）中那样。

paragraphs.en: Block Sparse Attention (Tree) : sparse attention whose indexer searches a tree over blocks of the keys of the attention itself, as in HiP ( Lee et al., 2025a ) and PISA ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . To represent these methods, we search a tree over blocks of keys directly on the KV cache, without training, which uses the full keys and favours accuracy over performance. We use blocks of eight keys, the most accurate of the sizes we compare (Appendix E.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 块稀疏注意力（树）：一种稀疏注意力，其索引器在注意力本身键的块上搜索树，如 HiP（Lee et al., 2025a）和 PISA（Tang et al., 2026）。 为了代表这类方法，我们直接在 KV 缓存上对键的块搜索树，无需训练，使用完整的键并以精度优先于性能。 我们使用八个键的块，这是我们比较的各尺寸中最精确的（附录 E.6）。

sents.en: Block Sparse Attention (Tree) : sparse attention whose indexer searches a tree over blocks of the keys of the attention itself, as in HiP ( Lee et al., 2025a ) and PISA ( Tang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 块稀疏注意力（树）：一种稀疏注意力，其索引器在注意力本身键的块上搜索树，如 HiP（Lee et al., 2025a）和 PISA（Tang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: We use blocks of eight keys, the most accurate of the sizes we compare (Appendix E.6 ).
sents.zh: 我们使用八个键的块，这是我们比较的各尺寸中最精确的（附录 E.6）。

paragraphs.en: D-LSA (Flat) and D-LSA (Tree) : D-LSA with a flat search over every bucket centroid and with a tree search over the hierarchy of buckets. In decode, each request processes one token per step, and the tree search runs its levels one after another, which pays off only when many requests decode together. As we evaluate one request at a time, D-LSA (Tree) decodes with the flat search (Appendix F.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: D-LSA（扁平）与 D-LSA（树）：D-LSA 对每个桶的质心进行扁平搜索，以及对桶的层次结构进行树搜索。 在解码阶段，每个请求每步处理一个词元，树搜索逐层依次执行，只有当许多请求一起解码时才能体现收益。 由于我们每次只评估一个请求，D-LSA（树）在解码时采用扁平搜索（附录 F.1）。

sents.en: D-LSA (Flat) and D-LSA (Tree) : D-LSA with a flat search over every bucket centroid and with a tree search over the hierarchy of buckets.
sents.zh: D-LSA（扁平）与 D-LSA（树）：D-LSA 对每个桶的质心进行扁平搜索，以及对桶的层次结构进行树搜索。

sents.en: In decode, each request processes one token per step, and the tree search runs its levels one after another, which pays off only when many requests decode together.

sents.en: As we evaluate one request at a time, D-LSA (Tree) decodes with the flat search (Appendix F.1 ).
sents.zh: 由于我们每次只评估一个请求，D-LSA（树）在解码时采用扁平搜索（附录 F.1）。

paragraphs.en: D-LSA (Training-Free) : D-LSA (Flat) with the principal directions of the keys as both projections instead of trained ones.
paragraphs.zh: D-LSA（免训练）：D-LSA（扁平版），以键的主方向作为两个投影，替代训练得到的投影。

paragraphs.en: Every trained indexer we compare is distilled in the same way to ensure fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对比的每一个经过训练的索引器（indexer）都以相同的方式进行蒸馏，以确保公平性。

paragraphs.en: Design parameters. Table 2 lists the parameters of every method per model. For D-LSA, we found that a budget of k = 4096 k=4096 long-range keys holds accuracy past 1M tokens better than smaller budgets, and these extra keys cost little next to the scan of the indexer they replace. On GLM-5.3-Flash , D-LSA (Flat) selects k = 2048 k=2048 long-range keys for queries before position 1M and k = 4096 k=4096 beyond. We found that the smaller budget keeps accuracy below 1M tokens while making the attention faster. Tuning the budget further, for example per layer or per request, is left to future work. A small index space of d ( idx ) = 64 d^{(\mathrm{idx})}=64 dimensions keeps the scoring and the clustering cheap, and we found wider spaces to add little accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 设计参数。 表 2 列出了每个模型下各方法的参数。 对于 D-LSA，我们发现 k = 4096 的长程键预算比更小的预算能更好地在超过 1M 词元时保持精度，而且与它们所替代的索引器扫描相比，这些额外的键开销很小。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，D-LSA (Flat) 对位置 1M 之前的查询选择 k = 2048 的长程键，对位置 1M 之后的选择 k = 4096。 我们发现，较小的预算在 1M 词元以内保持精度的同时，使注意力计算更快。 进一步调整预算，例如按层或按请求调整，留待未来工作。 维度为 d^{(\mathrm{idx})}=64 的小索引空间使评分和聚类的开销很低，我们发现更宽的空间几乎不增加精度。

paragraphs.en: Indexer distillation. We train on 352M tokens of documents of 16k to 1M tokens from seven domains, for 48k steps, each on 128 queries sampled from one document, with a learning rate of 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4} . This is a fraction of the 2.1B tokens of the dense warm-up of DSA. In Equation 2 , the target A i A_{i} keeps only the 2,048 keys with the most attention weight per query, renormalised over them, while A ^ i \hat{A}_{i} still spans all of ℛ i \mathcal{R}_{i} , and τ \tau is calibrated per layer before the first step. Unlike DSA, we do not follow the distillation by training the whole model under sparse attention (sparse training), a step D-LSA also supports but we omit here due to its cost. We provide further details about the composition and construction of the dataset in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 索引器蒸馏。 我们在来自七个领域、长度为 16k 至 1M token 的 352M token 文档上进行训练，共 48k 步，每步从一个文档中采样 128 个查询，学习率为 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4}。 这只是 DSA 稠密预热所用 2.1B token 中的一部分。 在公式 2 中，目标 A i A_{i} 对每个查询仅保留注意力权重最高的 2,048 个键，并在其上重新归一化，而 A ^ i \hat{A}_{i} 仍覆盖全部 ℛ i \mathcal{R}_{i}，且 τ \tau 在第一步之前按层进行校准。 与 DSA 不同，我们没有在蒸馏之后进行稀疏注意力下的整个模型训练（稀疏训练），D-LSA 也支持该步骤，但出于成本考虑我们在此省略。 我们在附录 C 中提供了关于数据集构成与构建的更多细节。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate accuracy in three categories, each with a representative set of benchmarks. For knowledge, we use MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) (a stratified sample of 2,000 questions) and GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) . For reasoning, we use AIME25 (four repeats) and MATH500 ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) (100 problems). For long context, we use LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2025 ) (60 questions) and the 13 tasks of RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) from 4k to 10M tokens (100 prompts per task up to 1M and 20 beyond). Evaluating each benchmark in full at ultra-long context is prohibitively expensive, and we therefore use the subsets given in parentheses.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在三个类别上评估准确性，每个类别都使用一组有代表性的基准测试。 在知识方面，我们使用 MMLU-Pro（Wang et al., 2024）（2000 道题的分层抽样）和 GPQA-Diamond（Rein et al., 2024）。 在推理方面，我们使用 AIME25（四次重复）和 MATH500（Lightman et al., 2024）（100 道题）。 在长上下文方面，我们使用 LongBench v2（Bai et al., 2025）（60 道题）以及 RULER（Hsieh et al., 2024）从 4k 到 10M token 的 13 项任务（每项任务在 1M 以内为 100 条提示词，超过 1M 为 20 条）。 在超长上下文下完整评估每个基准测试的代价过高，因此我们使用括号中给出的子集。

paragraphs.en: PaperTrail. To better understand model capabilities in a less synthetic ultra-long context setting, we extend RULER with a set of new tasks called PaperTrail. The tasks are constructed by embedding a trail of fabricated facts in a large collection of scientific papers. All papers are recent, almost all published after the release date of the models, such that no model could have seen them in training. A question can only be answered by finding the facts of its trail and connecting them, as in a literature search. Samples are built in three domains: exoplanets, long-context machine learning and quantum error correction. The questions come in three tiers of increasing difficulty, where tier 1 recalls a fact from one paper, tier 2 links facts across two papers and tier 3 traces a trail across three or more. We provide further details about the construction of PaperTrail in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: PaperTrail。 为了在非高度合成的超长上下文环境中更好地理解模型能力，我们用一组名为 PaperTrail 的新任务扩展了 RULER。 这些任务通过在大量科学论文集合中嵌入一串捏造的事实而构建。 所有论文都很新，几乎全部发布于模型发布日期之后，因此任何模型都不可能在训练中见过它们。 一个问题只有在其事实串被找到并连接起来后才能回答，就像文献检索一样。 样本在三个领域构建：系外行星、长上下文机器学习和量子纠错。 问题分为三个难度递增的层级：层级 1 回忆来自一篇论文的事实，层级 2 连接跨两篇论文的事实，层级 3 追踪跨三篇或更多论文的事实串。 我们在附录 D 中提供关于 PaperTrail 构建的更多细节。

paragraphs.en: Model sampling. We configure each model’s sampling as recommended by its model card with generation up to 163,840 tokens (Appendix E ). Qwen-3.8-27B reaches 10M tokens with YaRN ( Peng et al., 2024 ) at factor 40 (42 for PaperTrail at 10M), while GLM-5.3-Flash needs no extension as it has no explicit positional encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 模型采样。 我们按照各模型卡片的建议配置每个模型的采样，生成长度上限为 163,840 个 token（附录 E）。 Qwen-3.8-27B 通过 YaRN（Peng et al., 2024）在因子 40 下扩展到 10M token（PaperTrail 在 10M 时为 42），而 GLM-5.3-Flash 无需扩展，因为它没有显式的位置编码。

sents.en: Model sampling.
sents.zh: 模型采样。

paragraphs.en: Hardware and serving. We serve all models in SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) on H200 and B300 GPUs. To show that D-LSA can be integrated with the main parallelism strategies, we evaluate it with tensor parallelism (TP8) and with context parallelism in both prefill and decode (CP8). We show more details in Appendix F.2 . All accuracy measurements use context parallelism wherever the KV cache of a request outgrows the memory of a single GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件与推理服务。 我们在 H200 和 B300 GPU 上使用 SGLang（Zheng et al., 2024）服务所有模型。 为了展示 D-LSA 可以与主流并行策略集成，我们在张量并行（TP8）以及预填充和解码阶段的上下文并行（CP8）下对其进行评估。 我们在附录 F.2 中展示了更多细节。 只要某个请求的 KV 缓存超出单个 GPU 的内存容量，所有精度测量都使用上下文并行。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows that on knowledge, reasoning and long-context tasks, D-LSA stays close to the accuracy of baseline Full Attention on Qwen-3.8-27B and of baseline sparse attention on GLM-5.3-Flash . PaperTrail further shows how well the models find and connect facts across large collections of scientific papers.
paragraphs.zh: 图5显示，在知识、推理和长上下文任务上，D-LSA 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上保持接近基线全注意力的准确率，在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上保持接近基线稀疏注意力的准确率。 PaperTrail 进一步展示了模型在大量科学论文集合中查找并关联事实的能力有多好。

sents.zh: PaperTrail 进一步展示了模型在大量科学论文集合中查找并关联事实的能力有多好。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge and reasoning. On knowledge, reasoning and LongBench v2, D-LSA stays within the 95% confidence interval of both baselines, even with reasoning growing to tens of thousands of tokens (Appendix E ). We further show that D-LSA does not measurably affect the length of the reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 知识与推理。 在知识、推理以及 LongBench v2 上，即使推理长度增长到数万 token，D-LSA 仍保持在两个基线的 95% 置信区间内（附录 E）。 我们进一步表明，D-LSA 对推理长度没有可测量的影响。

sents.en: Knowledge and reasoning.
sents.zh: 知识与推理。

sents.en: On knowledge, reasoning and LongBench v2, D-LSA stays within the 95% confidence interval of both baselines, even with reasoning growing to tens of thousands of tokens (Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 在知识、推理以及 LongBench v2 上，即使推理长度增长到数万 token，D-LSA 仍保持在两个基线的 95% 置信区间内（附录 E）。

sents.en: We further show that D-LSA does not measurably affect the length of the reasoning.
sents.zh: 我们进一步表明，D-LSA 对推理长度没有可测量的影响。

paragraphs.en: Long context. On Qwen-3.8-27B , D-LSA (Flat) stays within 5 points of baseline Full Attention up to 1M tokens and exceeds it at 10M tokens, at 63.9 against 59.9 on RULER and 29.1 against 19.8 on PaperTrail. It also stays above Block Sparse Attention (Flat) on RULER from 128k tokens on, in a fair comparison, as both indexers are distilled the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 长上下文。 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，D-LSA（Flat）在长达 1M token 的范围内保持在基线全注意力（Full Attention）5 分以内，并在 10M token 时实现超越：在 RULER 上为 63.9 对 59.9，在 PaperTrail 上为 29.1 对 19.8。 在公平比较下（两种索引器采用相同的蒸馏方式），从 128k token 开始，它在 RULER 上也始终高于块稀疏注意力（Block Sparse Attention，Flat）。

sents.en: Long context.
sents.zh: 长上下文。

sents.zh: 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，D-LSA（Flat）在长达 1M token 的范围内保持在基线全注意力（Full Attention）5 分以内，并在 10M token 时实现超越：在 RULER 上为 63.9 对 59.9，在 PaperTrail 上为 29.1 对 19.8。

paragraphs.en: On GLM-5.3-Flash , D-LSA (Flat) stays within 3 points of baseline sparse attention up to 1M tokens, trails it by up to 8 points at 2M to 5M tokens, and is within 4 points on RULER at 10M tokens. This comparison favours the baseline, which was trained together with the model, while D-LSA (Flat) is distilled from attention that is already sparse (with no finetuning of the base model itself). On both models, MultiKey 2, MultiKey 3 and CWE fall the most for every method, the baselines included. We break down RULER by task and PaperTrail by tier in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，D-LSA (Flat) 在最多 100 万 token 范围内与基线稀疏注意力的差距保持在 3 分以内，在 200 万至 500 万 token 时最多落后 8 分，而在 1000 万 token 的 RULER 上差距保持在 4 分以内。 这一对比对基线有利，因为基线是与模型一起训练的，而 D-LSA (Flat) 是从本身已经稀疏化的注意力蒸馏而来（且未对基础模型本身进行微调）。 在两个模型上，MultiKey 2、MultiKey 3 和 CWE 是每种方法（包括各基线）下降最多的任务。 我们在附录 E 中按任务拆解 RULER，并按层级拆解 PaperTrail。

sents.en: We break down RULER by task and PaperTrail by tier in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Design comparison. D-LSA (Tree) follows D-LSA (Flat) on Qwen-3.8-27B , but loses accuracy past 1M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash , at 55.8 against 66.8 on RULER at 10M tokens. Block Sparse Attention (Tree) falls behind from 512k tokens, to about 63 on RULER at 1M tokens on both models, against 78 and 88 for D-LSA (Tree), and we therefore do not evaluate it beyond 1M tokens. Large blocks fall earlier (Appendix E.6 ). D-LSA (Training-Free), without any training, stays close to D-LSA (Flat) on Qwen-3.8-27B , but trails it on GLM-5.3-Flash .
paragraphs.zh: 设计对比。 D-LSA (Tree) 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上紧随 D-LSA (Flat)，但在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上超过 1M token 后精度下降，在 10M token 的 RULER 上为 55.8，对比 66.8。 Block Sparse Attention (Tree) 从 512k token 开始落后，在两个模型上 1M token 的 RULER 上约为 63，而 D-LSA (Tree) 分别为 78 和 88，因此我们不再在超过 1M token 的范围上对其进行评估。 较大的块更早失效（附录 E.6）。 D-LSA (Training-Free) 无需任何训练，在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上接近 D-LSA (Flat)，但在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上落后于它。

sents.en: Design comparison.
sents.zh: 设计对比。

sents.en: D-LSA (Tree) follows D-LSA (Flat) on Qwen-3.8-27B , but loses accuracy past 1M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash , at 55.8 against 66.8 on RULER at 10M tokens.
sents.zh: D-LSA (Tree) 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上紧随 D-LSA (Flat)，但在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上超过 1M token 后精度下降，在 10M token 的 RULER 上为 55.8，对比 66.8。

paragraphs.en: D-LSA follows the accuracy of the baselines, showing that our semantic clustering can preserve accuracy up to 10M tokens. However, we do observe a steep drop in accuracy beyond 512k tokens for Block Sparse Attention (Tree).
paragraphs.zh: D-LSA 的准确率与各基线方法相当，表明我们的语义聚类在多达 1000 万 token 时仍能保持准确率。 然而，我们确实观察到块稀疏注意力（树形）在超过 512k token 后准确率急剧下降。

sents.zh: D-LSA 的准确率与各基线方法相当，表明我们的语义聚类在多达 1000 万 token 时仍能保持准确率。

paragraphs.en: Next, we evaluate the performance of D-LSA. We first measure a single attention layer and then the whole model in production serving.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们评估 D-LSA 的性能。 我们首先测量单个注意力层，然后在生产服务中测量整个模型。

sents.en: Next, we evaluate the performance of D-LSA.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们评估 D-LSA 的性能。

sents.en: We first measure a single attention layer and then the whole model in production serving.
sents.zh: 我们首先测量单个注意力层，然后在生产服务中测量整个模型。

paragraphs.en: Methodology. For one layer, we time the whole attention module, including its projections, the indexer and the attention, on a single GPU. In prefill, we time the last chunk of 32,768 queries before the given context. In decode, we time one step of one request with CUDA graph enabled (clustering is amortised across the steps). For the whole model, we serve each method in SGLang with prefill chunks of 32,768 tokens, and measure the time to first token (TTFT) and the time per output token (TPOT) of one request at a time, the median of three requests of 256 output tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 对于单层，我们在单个 GPU 上对整个注意力模块计时，包括其投影、索引器和注意力计算。 在预填充阶段，我们对给定上下文之前最后一个包含 32,768 个查询的块进行计时。 在解码阶段，我们在启用 CUDA 图的情况下对一个请求的单步进行计时（聚类的开销在各步骤间被摊销）。 对于整个模型，我们使用 SGLang 以 32,768 个 token 的预填充块来服务每种方法，并每次测量一个请求的首 token 时间（TTFT）和每个输出 token 的时间（TPOT），取三个各生成 256 个输出 token 的请求的中位数。

sents.en: Methodology.
sents.zh: 方法。

sents.en: For one layer, we time the whole attention module, including its projections, the indexer and the attention, on a single GPU.
sents.zh: 对于单层，我们在单个 GPU 上对整个注意力模块计时，包括其投影、索引器和注意力计算。

sents.en: In prefill, we time the last chunk of 32,768 queries before the given context.
sents.zh: 在预填充阶段，我们对给定上下文之前最后一个包含 32,768 个查询的块进行计时。

sents.en: In decode, we time one step of one request with CUDA graph enabled (clustering is amortised across the steps).
sents.zh: 在解码阶段，我们在启用 CUDA 图的情况下对一个请求的单步进行计时（聚类的开销在各步骤间被摊销）。

sents.en: For the whole model, we serve each method in SGLang with prefill chunks of 32,768 tokens, and measure the time to first token (TTFT) and the time per output token (TPOT) of one request at a time, the median of three requests of 256 output tokens.
sents.zh: 对于整个模型，我们使用 SGLang 以 32,768 个 token 的预填充块来服务每种方法，并每次测量一个请求的首 token 时间（TTFT）和每个输出 token 的时间（TPOT），取三个各生成 256 个输出 token 的请求的中位数。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows that the prefill speedup of D-LSA grows with the context. On GLM-5.3-Flash , it rises from 3.5 × \times at 1M to 22.7 × \times at 10M tokens over baseline sparse attention, and on Qwen-3.8-27B to 72.4 × \times at 10M tokens over baseline Full Attention. Below 1M tokens, the gain is smaller, at 2.1 × \times at 512k tokens, as the scan of every block is still cheap. Extrapolated beyond 10M tokens, the prefill of D-LSA (Tree) grows subquadratically and overtakes the flat search, and at 100M tokens it is predicted to be more than 90 × \times faster than baseline sparse attention.
paragraphs.zh: 图6显示，D-LSA 的预填充加速比随上下文长度增长。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，相对于基线稀疏注意力，加速比从 100 万 token 时的 3.5 × \times 提升到 1000 万 token 时的 22.7 × \times；在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，相对于基线全注意力，1000 万 token 时达到 72.4 × \times。 在 100 万 token 以下时，增益较小，例如 512k token 时为 2.1 × \times，因为对每个块的扫描代价仍然很低。 外推到 1000 万 token 以上时，D-LSA（Tree）的预填充呈亚二次增长并超越扁平搜索；预计在 1 亿 token 时，其速度比基线稀疏注意力快 90 × \times 以上。

sents.en: Figure 6 shows that the prefill speedup of D-LSA grows with the context.
sents.zh: 图6显示，D-LSA 的预填充加速比随上下文长度增长。

sents.en: On GLM-5.3-Flash , it rises from 3.5 × \times at 1M to 22.7 × \times at 10M tokens over baseline sparse attention, and on Qwen-3.8-27B to 72.4 × \times at 10M tokens over baseline Full Attention.
sents.zh: 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，相对于基线稀疏注意力，加速比从 100 万 token 时的 3.5 × \times 提升到 1000 万 token 时的 22.7 × \times；在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，相对于基线全注意力，1000 万 token 时达到 72.4 × \times。

sents.en: Below 1M tokens, the gain is smaller, at 2.1 × \times at 512k tokens, as the scan of every block is still cheap.
sents.zh: 在 100 万 token 以下时，增益较小，例如 512k token 时为 2.1 × \times，因为对每个块的扫描代价仍然很低。

sents.en: Extrapolated beyond 10M tokens, the prefill of D-LSA (Tree) grows subquadratically and overtakes the flat search, and at 100M tokens it is predicted to be more than 90 × \times faster than baseline sparse attention.
sents.zh: 外推到 1000 万 token 以上时，D-LSA（Tree）的预填充呈亚二次增长并超越扁平搜索；预计在 1 亿 token 时，其速度比基线稀疏注意力快 90 × \times 以上。

paragraphs.en: Decode follows the same trend, with a speedup up to 4.6 × \times over baseline sparse attention and 42.5 × \times over baseline Full Attention at 10M tokens, with D-LSA (Tree) decoding with the flat search. On B300, D-LSA reaches 12.5 × \times and 42.9 × \times in prefill and 5.2 × \times and 18.4 × \times in decode at 10M tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 解码遵循同样的趋势，在1000万token时，相比基线稀疏注意力加速最高达4.6倍，相比基线全注意力加速达42.5倍，其中D-LSA（树）解码采用扁平搜索。 在B300上，D-LSA在1000万token时预填充分别达到12.5倍和42.9倍，解码分别达到5.2倍和18.4倍。

sents.en: Decode follows the same trend, with a speedup up to 4.6 × \times over baseline sparse attention and 42.5 × \times over baseline Full Attention at 10M tokens, with D-LSA (Tree) decoding with the flat search.
sents.zh: 解码遵循同样的趋势，在1000万token时，相比基线稀疏注意力加速最高达4.6倍，相比基线全注意力加速达42.5倍，其中D-LSA（树）解码采用扁平搜索。

sents.en: On B300, D-LSA reaches 12.5 × \times and 42.9 × \times in prefill and 5.2 × \times and 18.4 × \times in decode at 10M tokens.
sents.zh: 在B300上，D-LSA在1000万token时预填充分别达到12.5倍和42.9倍，解码分别达到5.2倍和18.4倍。

paragraphs.en: D-LSA also requires less memory for its indexer. Baseline sparse attention caches an index key for every block of four keys, while D-LSA caches one centroid in its smaller index space for every bucket of about eight keys, together with the id of each key. At 10M tokens, the index of D-LSA (Flat) takes 246 MiB per layer against 331 MiB in GLM-5.3-Flash and 642 MiB in QSA. Larger buckets would shrink the index of D-LSA further.
paragraphs.zh: D-LSA 的索引器所需的内存也更少。 基线稀疏注意力会为每四个键组成的块缓存一个索引键，而 D-LSA 在其更小的索引空间中为约八个键组成的桶缓存一个质心，并同时缓存每个键的 id。 在 1000 万 token 的规模下，D-LSA (Flat) 的索引每层占用 246 MiB，而 GLM-5.3-Flash 为 331 MiB，QSA 为 642 MiB。 更大的桶还能进一步缩小 D-LSA 的索引。

sents.en: D-LSA also requires less memory for its indexer.
sents.zh: D-LSA 的索引器所需的内存也更少。

sents.en: Baseline sparse attention caches an index key for every block of four keys, while D-LSA caches one centroid in its smaller index space for every bucket of about eight keys, together with the id of each key.
sents.zh: 基线稀疏注意力会为每四个键组成的块缓存一个索引键，而 D-LSA 在其更小的索引空间中为约八个键组成的桶缓存一个质心，并同时缓存每个键的 id。

sents.en: At 10M tokens, the index of D-LSA (Flat) takes 246 MiB per layer against 331 MiB in GLM-5.3-Flash and 642 MiB in QSA.
sents.zh: 在 1000 万 token 的规模下，D-LSA (Flat) 的索引每层占用 246 MiB，而 GLM-5.3-Flash 为 331 MiB，QSA 为 642 MiB。

sents.en: Larger buckets would shrink the index of D-LSA further.
sents.zh: 更大的桶还能进一步缩小 D-LSA 的索引。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end. Table 3 shows that the speedup of one layer carries over to the whole model at ultra-long context. On GLM-5.3-Flash , D-LSA (Flat) is on par with baseline sparse attention up to 1M tokens with CP8 and already 1.5 × \times faster to first token at 1M with TP8, and at 10M tokens reduces the TTFT by 2.2 × \times and the TPOT by 2.1 × \times with CP8, and by 5.8 × \times and 1.9 × \times with TP8. On Qwen-3.8-27B , it reduces them by 9.2 × \times and 2.9 × \times at 10M tokens against baseline Full Attention. On B300, D-LSA (Flat) reduces the TTFT and the TPOT at 10M tokens by 1.6 × \times and 2.2 × \times with CP8 and by 4.8 × \times and 2.6 × \times with TP8 on GLM-5.3-Flash , and by 5.7 × \times and 1.5 × \times on Qwen-3.8-27B . The speedup of the whole model is expected to be smaller than that of one layer, as only the global attention layers become faster, while the other layers keep their cost.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端。 表 3 表明，单层的加速在超长上下文下可以延续到整个模型。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，D-LSA (Flat) 在使用 CP8 时在最高 1M token 范围内与基线稀疏注意力持平，并且在 1M 时使用 TP8 已实现 1.5 × \times 的首 token 提速；在 10M token 时，使用 CP8 将 TTFT 降低 2.2 × \times、将 TPOT 降低 2.1 × \times，使用 TP8 则分别降低 5.8 × \times 和 1.9 × \times。 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，在 10M token 时相比基线全注意力（Full Attention），它将二者分别降低 9.2 × \times 和 2.9 × \times。 在 B300 上，D-LSA (Flat) 在 10M token 时，于 GLM-5.3-Flash 上使用 CP8 将 TTFT 和 TPOT 分别降低 1.6 × \times 和 2.2 × \times，使用 TP8 分别降低 4.8 × \times 和 2.6 × \times；在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上则分别降低 5.7 × \times 和 1.5 × \times。 整个模型的加速预计会小于单层的加速，因为只有全局注意力层变得更快，而其他层保持原有开销。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we evaluate N-LSA, which is trained natively on the NTP loss alone.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们评估 N-LSA，它仅基于 NTP 损失进行原生训练。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We train a hybrid model of about 0.5B parameters with 24 layers, in which every fourth layer is an attention layer and the others are Gated DeltaNet layers ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . Each attention layer has 8 query heads over a single key-value head of 128 dimensions, without positional encoding. We pre-train with a standard Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) learning rate schedule ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , on 100B tokens of FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) at a context of 4k tokens in the Warmup and Stable phases, followed by 12B tokens of LongDocs in the Decay phase, at 128k tokens (Appendix C ). We compare N-LSA with Full Attention, Sliding Window Attention (SWA), and the native forms of block sparse attention, NSA ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) for Block Sparse Attention (Flat) and PISA ( Tang et al., 2026 ) for Block Sparse Attention (Tree), all in the same model architecture and on the same data. Every sparse method attends to about 2,560 keys per query. N-LSA selects k = 2048 k=2048 long-range keys with flat search, next to a window of 512 keys and 4 sink keys. SWA attends to a window of 2,560 keys and 4 sink keys, NSA attends to 32 selected blocks of 64 keys and a window of 512 keys, and PISA attends to 40 blocks of 64 keys, which always include the first block and the two most recent blocks (window). We train N-LSA with flat search only, and leave native training with tree search to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 我们训练了一个约 0.5B 参数、24 层的混合模型，其中每四层有一个注意力层，其余为门控 DeltaNet（Gated DeltaNet）层（Yang et al., 2025b）。 每个注意力层在单一 128 维键值头之上设置 8 个查询头，且不使用位置编码。 我们采用标准的预热-稳定-衰减（Warmup-Stable-Decay, WSD）学习率调度（Hu et al., 2024）进行预训练：在预热和稳定阶段以 4k token 上下文在 100B token 的 FineWeb-Edu（Penedo et al., 2024）上训练，随后在衰减阶段以 128k token 上下文在 12B token 的 LongDocs 上训练（附录 C）。 我们将 N-LSA 与全注意力、滑动窗口注意力（SWA）、块稀疏注意力的原生形式——即用于块稀疏注意力（Flat）的 NSA（Yuan et al., 2025）和用于块稀疏注意力（Tree）的 PISA（Tang et al., 2026）——进行比较，所有方法均使用相同的模型架构并在相同数据上训练。 每种稀疏方法对每个查询大约关注 2,560 个键。 N-LSA 通过扁平搜索选择 k = 2048 k=2048 个长程键，外加 512 个键的窗口和 4 个 sinks 键。 SWA 关注 2,560 个键的窗口和 4 个 sinks 键；NSA 关注 32 个选定的块（每块 64 个键）以及 512 个键的窗口；PISA 关注 40 个块（每块 64 个键），其中始终包含第一个块和最近的两个块（窗口）。 我们仅用扁平搜索训练 N-LSA，将使用树搜索的原生训练留作未来工作。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows that N-LSA reaches the validation loss of Full Attention throughout the decay phase at 128k token context, at 1.085 against 1.085, while PISA, NSA and SWA trail at 1.100, 1.117 and 1.154. During pre-training at 4k tokens, all methods stay within 0.004 of each other, as their keys cover most of the context. Table 4 confirms this on downstream tasks. On commonsense reasoning ( Clark et al., 2018 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ) , all models are on par. On recall ( Arora et al., 2024 ) , N-LSA stays close to Full Attention and ahead of the other sparse methods. On RULER, N-LSA stays within 3.5 points of Full Attention up to 128k tokens, at 32.2 against 34.7 at 128k tokens, while NSA and PISA fall to 19.2 and 14.6, and SWA to 3.0 once the context outgrows its window.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 显示，在 128k token 上下文的整个衰减阶段中，N-LSA 达到了与 Full Attention 相同的验证损失，为 1.085 对 1.085，而 PISA、NSA 和 SWA 分别落后于 1.100、1.117 和 1.154。 在 4k token 的预训练阶段，各方法之间的差距保持在 0.004 以内，因为它们的键覆盖了大部分上下文。 表 4 在下游任务上证实了这一点。 在常识推理任务上（Clark et al., 2018；Zellers et al., 2019），所有模型表现相当。 在召回任务上（Arora et al., 2024），N-LSA 保持在接近 Full Attention 的水平，并领先于其他稀疏方法。 在 RULER 上，N-LSA 在最多 128k token 的范围内与 Full Attention 的差距保持在 3.5 分以内，在 128k token 时为 32.2 对 34.7，而 NSA 和 PISA 分别降至 19.2 和 14.6，一旦上下文超出其窗口，SWA 更是降至 3.0。

sents.en: Figure 7 shows that N-LSA reaches the validation loss of Full Attention throughout the decay phase at 128k token context, at 1.085 against 1.085, while PISA, NSA and SWA trail at 1.100, 1.117 and 1.154.

sents.en: On RULER, N-LSA stays within 3.5 points of Full Attention up to 128k tokens, at 32.2 against 34.7 at 128k tokens, while NSA and PISA fall to 19.2 and 14.6, and SWA to 3.0 once the context outgrows its window.
sents.zh: 在 RULER 上，N-LSA 在最多 128k token 的范围内与 Full Attention 的差距保持在 3.5 分以内，在 128k token 时为 32.2 对 34.7，而 NSA 和 PISA 分别降至 19.2 和 14.6，一旦上下文超出其窗口，SWA 更是降至 3.0。

paragraphs.en: N-LSA also trains faster than Full Attention at long context. For one attention layer on a single GPU, the forward and backward pass of N-LSA is 1.1 × \times faster than Full Attention with FlashAttention-3 ( Shah et al., 2024 ) at 64k tokens and 1.6 × \times faster at 128k tokens (Figure 7 , left). End to end, the whole model completes its decay phase 1.24 × \times faster at the same validation loss (Figure 7 , right), as only every fourth layer is an attention layer. At shorter contexts, the selection of the keys costs more than it saves. Its peak memory is higher, at 6.8 GiB against 5.8 GiB per layer at 128k tokens, partly because N-LSA keeps the indices of the selected keys of every query for the backward pass, which grow linearly with the context.
paragraphs.zh: N-LSA 在长上下文下的训练速度也比 Full Attention 更快。 在单 GPU 上对一个注意力层进行测试，在 64k token 时 N-LSA 的前向和反向传播比使用 FlashAttention-3（Shah 等，2024）的 Full Attention 快 1.1 × \times 倍，在 128k token 时快 1.6 × \times 倍（图 7，左）。 端到端来看，由于每四层才有一个注意力层，整个模型在相同验证损失下的衰减阶段完成速度快 1.24 × \times 倍（图 7，右）。 在较短上下文中，对 key 进行选择的开销超过了它所节省的开销。 其峰值显存更高，在 128k token 时每层为 6.8 GiB，而 Full Attention 为 5.8 GiB，部分原因是 N-LSA 会为反向传播保留每个 query 所选 key 的索引，而这些索引随上下文线性增长。

sents.en: N-LSA also trains faster than Full Attention at long context.
sents.zh: N-LSA 在长上下文下的训练速度也比 Full Attention 更快。

sents.en: End to end, the whole model completes its decay phase 1.24 × \times faster at the same validation loss (Figure 7 , right), as only every fourth layer is an attention layer.
sents.zh: 端到端来看，由于每四层才有一个注意力层，整个模型在相同验证损失下的衰减阶段完成速度快 1.24 × \times 倍（图 7，右）。

sents.zh: 在较短上下文中，对 key 进行选择的开销超过了它所节省的开销。

sents.en: Its peak memory is higher, at 6.8 GiB against 5.8 GiB per layer at 128k tokens, partly because N-LSA keeps the indices of the selected keys of every query for the backward pass, which grow linearly with the context.

paragraphs.en: Overall, N-LSA trains natively at the accuracy of Full Attention and becomes faster as the context grows.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，N-LSA 以全注意力（Full Attention）的精度进行原生训练，并随着上下文的增长而变得更快。

paragraphs.en: LSA reduces the cost of finding the keys, but not of storing them, and the KV cache still grows linearly with the context. It is orthogonal to methods that compress the KV cache ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) , share the index across layers ( Bai et al., 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026b ) , or predict several tokens per step ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) , and could be combined with each.
paragraphs.zh: LSA 降低了查找键的成本，但并没有降低存储键的成本，且 KV 缓存仍然随上下文线性增长。 它与压缩 KV 缓存（DeepSeek-AI, 2026a）、跨层共享索引（Bai et al., 2026; DeepSeek-AI, 2026b）或每步预测多个词元（Gloeckle et al., 2024; DeepSeek-AI, 2024）的方法正交，并且可以与其中每一种方法相结合。

sents.en: LSA reduces the cost of finding the keys, but not of storing them, and the KV cache still grows linearly with the context.
sents.zh: LSA 降低了查找键的成本，但并没有降低存储键的成本，且 KV 缓存仍然随上下文线性增长。

sents.en: It is orthogonal to methods that compress the KV cache ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) , share the index across layers ( Bai et al., 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026b ) , or predict several tokens per step ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) , and could be combined with each.
sents.zh: 它与压缩 KV 缓存（DeepSeek-AI, 2026a）、跨层共享索引（Bai et al., 2026; DeepSeek-AI, 2026b）或每步预测多个词元（Gloeckle et al., 2024; DeepSeek-AI, 2024）的方法正交，并且可以与其中每一种方法相结合。

paragraphs.en: We observed tree search to lose accuracy faster than flat search past 1M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash , while it overtakes flat search in decode only from about 5M tokens with one request, and is predicted to do so in prefill only beyond 10M tokens. It remains open whether sparse training would close this gap beyond indexer distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上超过 1M token 后，树搜索的精度下降速度快于扁平搜索；而在单请求解码场景下，它要到大约 5M token 才开始超越扁平搜索，预计在预填充场景下则要到 10M token 之后才会超越。 至于稀疏训练能否在索引器蒸馏之外缩小这一差距，目前仍是开放问题。

sents.en: We observed tree search to lose accuracy faster than flat search past 1M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash , while it overtakes flat search in decode only from about 5M tokens with one request, and is predicted to do so in prefill only beyond 10M tokens.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上超过 1M token 后，树搜索的精度下降速度快于扁平搜索；而在单请求解码场景下，它要到大约 5M token 才开始超越扁平搜索，预计在预填充场景下则要到 10M token 之后才会超越。

sents.en: It remains open whether sparse training would close this gap beyond indexer distillation.
sents.zh: 至于稀疏训练能否在索引器蒸馏之外缩小这一差距，目前仍是开放问题。

paragraphs.en: We train N-LSA at a small scale, with about 0.5B parameters, up to 128k tokens and with flat search only. Scaling native training to larger models, longer contexts and tree search remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在小规模下训练N-LSA，参数量约为0.5B，上下文长度最多128k个token，且仅使用平铺搜索。 将原生训练扩展到更大的模型、更长的上下文以及树搜索仍是待解决的问题。

sents.en: We train N-LSA at a small scale, with about 0.5B parameters, up to 128k tokens and with flat search only.
sents.zh: 我们在小规模下训练N-LSA，参数量约为0.5B，上下文长度最多128k个token，且仅使用平铺搜索。

sents.en: Scaling native training to larger models, longer contexts and tree search remains open.
sents.zh: 将原生训练扩展到更大的模型、更长的上下文以及树搜索仍是待解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: At ultra-long context, the cost of sparse attention lies in finding which keys to attend to. We introduce LSA, which clusters the keys in a learned latent space and replaces the scan of every key with a search over the clusters, flat or along a tree. D-LSA distils LSA into pre-trained models and stays close to the accuracy of their baseline attention up to 10M tokens. At 10M tokens, one attention layer of D-LSA prefills 22.7 × \times and decodes 4.6 × \times faster than sparse attention in GLM-5.3-Flash , and 72.4 × \times and 42.5 × \times faster than Full Attention in Qwen-3.8-27B . End to end, this reduces the time to first token by 2.2 × \times and 9.2 × \times , respectively. N-LSA trains LSA natively on the next-token loss alone, at the accuracy of Full Attention and 1.6 × \times faster per layer at 128k tokens. With tree search, the cost of finding the keys grows subquadratically, which makes LSA a step towards attention that scales well beyond 10M tokens. LSA thus provides a practical way forward for ultra-long context attention, both for distilling pre-trained models and for native training.
paragraphs.zh: 在超长上下文场景下，稀疏注意力的开销在于找出需要关注的键。 我们提出 LSA，它在学习到的潜在空间中对键进行聚类，并用对簇的搜索取代对每个键的遍历，搜索可以是平面的，也可以沿树形结构进行。 D-LSA 将 LSA 蒸馏到预训练模型中，在高达 10M 词元的长度下仍保持接近其基线注意力的准确率。 在 10M 词元长度下，GLM-5.3-Flash 中 D-LSA 的单个注意力层预填充速度比稀疏注意力快 22.7 × \times 倍、解码速度快 4.6 × \times 倍，而 Qwen-3.8-27B 中则比全注意力快 72.4 × \times 倍和 42.5 × \times 倍。 端到端来看，这分别将首个词元的生成时间缩短了 2.2 × \times 倍和 9.2 × \times 倍。 N-LSA 仅基于下一词元预测损失对 LSA 进行原生训练，在全注意力的准确率下，128k 词元长度时每层速度提升 1.6 × \times 倍。 采用树形搜索时，查找键的开销呈次二次增长，这使 LSA 成为迈向可扩展到远超 10M 词元的注意力的一步。 因此，LSA 为超长上下文注意力提供了一条切实可行的前进道路，既适用于蒸馏预训练模型，也适用于原生训练。

paragraphs.en: To test how many keys a query needs to keep accuracy, we let each query of Qwen-3.8-27B attend only to the sink, the window and its true top- k k keys (Figure 8 ). At 128k tokens, Top- k k Oracle Attention keeps 98% of the RULER accuracy of Full Attention down to k = 512 k=512 , while each query attends to 0.8% of the keys. Single-needle retrieval holds down to k = 16 k=16 , while MultiKey 2, MultiKey 3 and CWE fall first in accuracy. Therefore, sparse attention loses little if it finds the most relevant keys, which is what LSA is designed to do without scoring every key.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试一个查询需要保留多少个键才能维持准确率，我们让 Qwen-3.8-27B 的每个查询只关注 sink、窗口以及其真实的 top-k 个键（图 8）。 在 128k token 时，Top-k Oracle Attention 仅需 k=512 就能保持全注意力 98% 的 RULER 准确率，此时每个查询只关注 0.8% 的键。 单针检索在 k=16 时仍能保持，而 MultiKey 2、MultiKey 3 和 CWE 的准确率最先下降。 因此，如果稀疏注意力能找到最相关的键，其损失很小，而这正是 LSA 在不对每个键打分的情况下所要实现的目标。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we report additional details on the training dataset we use to train D-LSA under indexer distillation, and also train N-LSA in the decay phase: LongDocs .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们报告了在索引器蒸馏下用于训练 D-LSA 的训练数据集的更多细节，该数据集也用于在衰减阶段训练 N-LSA：LongDocs。

paragraphs.en: Source : a collection of documents, such as Project Gutenberg.
paragraphs.zh: 来源：文档集合，例如 Project Gutenberg（古登堡计划）。

paragraphs.en: Domain : a group of sources: books, academic, code, agentic, government, parliament and discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 领域：一组来源：书籍、学术、代码、智能体、政府、议会和讨论。

paragraphs.en: Document : one item of a source, such as a book, a paper, a code repository or an agent trace.
paragraphs.zh: 文档（Document）：来源中的一个条目，例如一本书、一篇论文、一个代码仓库或一条智能体轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Sequence : a contiguous part of one document, at a particular sequence length from 16k to 1M tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 序列：一份文档中连续的一部分，序列长度从 16k 到 1M 个词元（token）不等。

paragraphs.en: Sources. LongDocs is a collection of long documents from publicly available sources and in-house agent traces. Eight sources are publicly available: Project Gutenberg, DOAB, arXiv, USGPO, UK Hansard and Wikimedia from the filtered releases of the Common Pile ( Kandpal et al., 2025 ) , The Stack ( Kocetkov et al., 2023 ) , of which we take the Python and Java repositories, and the software engineering traces of Open-SWE-Traces ( NVIDIA, 2026e ) . The in-house agent traces are long sessions of agents that play games or solve long-context tasks, and they make up 13.1% of the training tokens. We use every public source as released.
paragraphs.zh: 数据来源。 LongDocs 是一个由来自公开来源的文档和内部智能体轨迹组成的长文档集合。 公开来源有八个：来自 Common Pile 过滤版（Kandpal et al., 2025）的 Project Gutenberg、DOAB、arXiv、USGPO、UK Hansard 和 Wikimedia，以及 The Stack（Kocetkov et al., 2023，我们选取其中的 Python 和 Java 代码库），还有 Open-SWE-Traces（NVIDIA, 2026e）的软件工程轨迹。 内部智能体轨迹是智能体玩游戏或解决长上下文任务的长时间会话，它们占训练 token 的 13.1%。 我们按发布原样使用每个公开来源。

sents.en: Sources.
sents.zh: 数据来源。

sents.en: LongDocs is a collection of long documents from publicly available sources and in-house agent traces.

paragraphs.en: Sequences. Each sequence comes from one document and never joins two documents. A code document is one repository, its files joined in the order of their paths, and an agent trace is one session rendered as text. We hold out 2% of the documents for validation.
paragraphs.zh: 序列。 每个序列都来自单个文档，绝不拼接两个文档。 代码文档是一个代码仓库，其文件按路径顺序拼接而成；智能体轨迹则是一个会话渲染成的文本。 我们留出 2% 的文档用于验证。

sents.zh: 序列。

paragraphs.en: Distillation training. We distil every indexer on a mix of 352M tokens drawn from LongDocs (Figure 9 ). The mix is uniformly sampled across domain and sequence length, with a bias towards longer context windows at 512k and 1M. In particular, we give each sequence length 32M tokens, and twice and four times as many to 512k and 1M. Sequences of 1M tokens thus hold about a third of the training tokens. We experimentally determine this choice to be beneficial, with +0.036 accuracy on RULER at 1M (averaged over 3 seeds, notable lifts in multikey_2 , multikey_3 , +0.35 and +0.15 respectively), while accuracy from 4k to 512k stays roughly identical. Within each length, every domain receives an equal share of the tokens. A domain with too few documents of that length gives its share to the others (parliament stops at 256k tokens and discussion at 512k).
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏训练。 我们在取自 LongDocs 的 3.52 亿 token 的混合数据上对每个索引器进行蒸馏（图 9）。 该混合数据在领域和序列长度上均匀采样，并偏向更长的上下文窗口，即 512k 和 1M。 具体而言，我们为每个序列长度分配 3200 万 token，并为 512k 和 1M 分别分配两倍和四倍的量。 因此，1M token 的序列大约占训练 token 的三分之一。 我们通过实验确定这一选择是有益的，在 1M 的 RULER 上准确率提升 0.036（对 3 个随机种子取平均，在 multikey_2 和 multikey_3 上有显著提升，分别为 +0.35 和 +0.15），而 4k 到 512k 的准确率大致保持不变。 在每个长度内，每个领域获得相等的 token 份额。 在该长度下文档过少的领域会将其份额让给其他领域（parliament 在 256k token 处截止，discussion 在 512k 处截止）。
