paragraphs.en: As part of this work, we introduce PaperTrail, an extension of the RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) benchmark that tests models at ultra-long context in a more realistic setting, inspired by real-life scientific literature review (Figure 10 ). Instead of finding a needle in synthetic text, a model finds facts spread across real scientific papers and connects them, as in a literature search. We use the following terminology:
paragraphs.zh: 作为这项工作的一部分，我们介绍了 PaperTrail，它是 RULER（Hsieh et al., 2024）基准的一个扩展，受现实生活中的科学文献综述启发（图 10），在更现实的设置中测试模型的超长上下文能力。 模型不再是在合成文本中大海捞针，而是要找出散布在真实科学论文中的事实并将它们联系起来，就像进行文献检索一样。 我们使用以下术语：

sents.en: As part of this work, we introduce PaperTrail, an extension of the RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) benchmark that tests models at ultra-long context in a more realistic setting, inspired by real-life scientific literature review (Figure 10 ).
sents.zh: 作为这项工作的一部分，我们介绍了 PaperTrail，它是 RULER（Hsieh et al., 2024）基准的一个扩展，受现实生活中的科学文献综述启发（图 10），在更现实的设置中测试模型的超长上下文能力。

sents.en: Instead of finding a needle in synthetic text, a model finds facts spread across real scientific papers and connects them, as in a literature search.
sents.zh: 模型不再是在合成文本中大海捞针，而是要找出散布在真实科学论文中的事实并将它们联系起来，就像进行文献检索一样。

sents.en: We use the following terminology:
sents.zh: 我们使用以下术语：

paragraphs.en: Sample : a collection of real arXiv preprints of 2026 from one domain.
paragraphs.zh: Sample：来自同一领域的 2026 年真实 arXiv 预印本的集合。

paragraphs.en: Trail : a chain of papers that introduces a result, cites it, and later revises and renames it.
paragraphs.zh: Trail：一系列论文组成的链条，这些论文引入了某个结果，引用了它，随后又对其进行修订并重新命名。

paragraphs.en: Fabricated paper : a paper we write for a trail.
paragraphs.zh: 伪造论文：我们为试验而撰写的一篇论文。

paragraphs.en: Host paper : a real paper into which we insert passages that cite or use facts from a fabricated paper.
paragraphs.zh: 主稿论文：一篇真实的论文，我们在其中插入引用或使用某篇捏造论文内容的段落。

paragraphs.en: Insertion : a passage we add to a host paper, which only adds sentences and never changes the text of the authors.
paragraphs.zh: 插入：指我们添加到宿主论文中的一段文字，它只增加句子，从不改变作者的原文。

paragraphs.en: Background paper : any other paper of a sample, real and unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 背景论文：样本中任何其他真实的、未作改动的论文。

paragraphs.en: Context. PaperTrail has three samples, on exoplanets , long-context machine learning and quantum error correction , with 1,246 papers in total. Each sample hides two trails (Trail A and Trail B). A trail has two fabricated papers and 8 to 9 insertions in 6 to 7 host papers, and background papers fill the rest of the context. An insertion places its references where an author would place them, such that a host paper reads naturally as before. Papers in the context are not presented in chronological order, and a host often comes before the paper it cites.
paragraphs.zh: 背景。 PaperTrail 有三个样本，分别关于系外行星、长上下文机器学习和量子纠错，共计 1,246 篇论文。 每个样本隐藏两条线索（线索 A 和线索 B）。 一条线索包含两篇伪造论文，以及在 6 到 7 篇宿主论文中的 8 到 9 处插入，其余上下文由背景论文填充。 每处插入将其参考文献放在作者通常放置的位置，使得宿主论文读起来与之前一样自然。 上下文中的论文并不按时间顺序呈现，宿主论文往往出现在它所引用的论文之前。

sents.en: Context.
sents.zh: 背景。

sents.en: PaperTrail has three samples, on exoplanets , long-context machine learning and quantum error correction , with 1,246 papers in total.
sents.zh: PaperTrail 有三个样本，分别关于系外行星、长上下文机器学习和量子纠错，共计 1,246 篇论文。

sents.en: Each sample hides two trails (Trail A and Trail B).
sents.zh: 每个样本隐藏两条线索（线索 A 和线索 B）。

sents.en: A trail has two fabricated papers and 8 to 9 insertions in 6 to 7 host papers, and background papers fill the rest of the context.
sents.zh: 一条线索包含两篇伪造论文，以及在 6 到 7 篇宿主论文中的 8 到 9 处插入，其余上下文由背景论文填充。

sents.en: An insertion places its references where an author would place them, such that a host paper reads naturally as before.
sents.zh: 每处插入将其参考文献放在作者通常放置的位置，使得宿主论文读起来与之前一样自然。

sents.en: Papers in the context are not presented in chronological order, and a host often comes before the paper it cites.
sents.zh: 上下文中的论文并不按时间顺序呈现，宿主论文往往出现在它所引用的论文之前。

paragraphs.en: Trails. The first fabricated paper of a trail introduces a result, for example AlloKV, a KV cache eviction method whose budget grows as the 0.43 power of the context length. Host papers cite and use it. Two to three weeks later, the second fabricated paper revises the value and renames the method, here to SuBA with an exponent of 0.61. Host papers posted after the revision either cite the new name or still quote the old value, as real literature often does.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹。 轨迹中的第一篇伪造论文引入一个结果，例如 AlloKV，一种 KV 缓存逐出方法，其预算随上下文长度的 0.43 次幂增长。 宿主论文引用并使用它。 两到三周后，第二篇伪造论文修改该数值并重命名该方法，这里改为 SuBA，指数为 0.61。 修改后发布的宿主论文要么引用新名称，要么仍引用旧数值，正如真实文献中常出现的那样。

sents.en: Trails.
sents.zh: 轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Questions. Each sample asks 30 scored questions, 10 per tier. A tier 1 question recalls a fact from one paper, a tier 2 question links two papers, and a tier 3 question links three or more papers, often the whole trail. Each sample also asks 6 questions whose answer is not in the papers, about an absent entity, a false premise or a near miss, which we report apart from the score (Table 8 ). The model ends its reply with the papers it used and its answer. A number counts within a relative tolerance of 2% by default, and a set of papers is scored by its F1 against the reference set.
paragraphs.zh: 问题。 每个样本包含 30 道计分问题，每个层级 10 道。 层级 1 的问题要求回忆单篇论文中的事实，层级 2 的问题需要关联两篇论文，层级 3 的问题则需要关联三篇或更多论文，通常是整条文献链。 每个样本还包含 6 道答案不在论文中的问题，涉及缺失的实体、错误的前提或近似错误，这部分我们单独报告，不计入总分（表 8）。 模型在回复的末尾给出它所使用的论文及其答案。 数值默认在 2% 的相对容差内计为正确，论文集合则根据其相对于参考集合的 F1 值来评分。

paragraphs.en: Context sizes. We build each sample at 512k, 1M, 2M, 5M and 10M tokens, and every size holds every paper of the size below. The fabricated and host papers, at most 18 per sample, are the same at every size. The background papers grow the context from 25 to 30 papers at 512k to 386 to 465 papers at 10M, and spread the trails over the whole context. The trails are fabricated, and every paper up to 5M was posted after the release of both Qwen-3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash , guaranteeing that no model has seen these papers in training. The 10M contexts hold papers posted at most six weeks before its release.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文规模。 我们在每个样本上分别构建 512k、1M、2M、5M 和 10M token 的版本，且每一规模都包含低于该规模的全部论文。 伪造论文和宿主论文（每个样本最多 18 篇）在所有规模下都是相同的。 背景论文使上下文从 512k 时的 25 到 30 篇增长到 10M 时的 386 到 465 篇，并将轨迹分布在整个上下文中。 轨迹是伪造的，且截至 5M 的每篇论文均在 Qwen-3.8-27B 和 GLM-5.3-Flash 发布之后才发布，从而保证没有模型在训练中见过这些论文。 10M 上下文中的论文最多在其发布前六周发布。

paragraphs.en: Controls. Four controls ask the same questions over parts of a sample: the question alone, the host papers without their insertions, the fabricated papers with the insertions alone, and the background papers alone. By construction, only the fabricated papers and the insertions hold the answers. We validate the controls with GLM-5.3-Flash and D-LSA (Training-Free) in Table 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 对照实验。 我们设置了四组对照，在样本的不同部分上提出相同的问题：仅问题本身、不含插入内容的主论文、仅含插入内容的伪造论文，以及仅背景论文。 从构造方式来看，只有伪造论文和插入内容包含答案。 我们在表 8 中用 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 D-LSA（免训练）对对照实验进行了验证。

sents.zh: 对照实验。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we show details of the evaluation setup, compare every method with its baseline on knowledge and reasoning, examine whether D-LSA changes the length of the reasoning, and break down the long-context results, RULER by task and PaperTrail by tier.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们展示评估设置的详细信息，将每种方法与其基线在知识与推理上进行比较，检验 D-LSA 是否会改变推理的长度，并按任务拆解 RULER 的长上下文结果、按层级拆解 PaperTrail 的结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists the setup of every benchmark. We sample Qwen-3.8-27B at temperature 1.0 with top-p 0.95, top-k 20, min-p 0 and no presence penalty, and GLM-5.3-Flash at temperature 1.0 with top-p 0.95, as their model cards recommend. On RULER, both models decode greedily with reasoning disabled. On every benchmark with reasoning, at most 4.6% of the replies reach the output cap of 163,840 tokens for any model and method.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 列出了每个基准测试的设置。 我们按照模型卡片的建议，对 Qwen-3.8-27B 采用温度 1.0、top-p 0.95、top-k 20、min-p 0 且无出现惩罚进行采样，对 GLM-5.3-Flash 采用温度 1.0、top-p 0.95 进行采样。 在 RULER 上，两个模型都在关闭推理的情况下进行贪心解码。 在所有启用推理的基准测试中，任何模型和方法下最多只有 4.6% 的回复达到 163,840 个 token 的输出上限。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 compares the reasoning length of each method with the baseline of its model, question by question. For each question, we average the reasoning tokens over its repeats and divide them by those of the baseline on the same question, and each marker is the geometric mean of these ratios over the benchmark. The grey band of a benchmark is the median width of the 95% bootstrap intervals of its methods, and a marker inside it shows no measurable change. Every D-LSA design stays inside its band, except D-LSA (Tree) on GPQA-Diamond with Qwen-3.8-27B , which reasons 11% shorter.
paragraphs.zh: 图12逐题比较了每种方法与其所属模型基线的推理长度。 对于每个问题，我们将多次重复的推理token取平均，再除以基线在同一问题上的推理token，每个标记是这些比率在整个基准上的几何平均。 某个基准的灰色区域是其各方法95%自举区间的中位宽度，落在该区域内的标记表示无可测量的变化。 除了D-LSA (Tree)在GPQA-Diamond上使用Qwen-3.8-27B时推理长度缩短11%外，每种D-LSA设计都保持在其灰色区域内。

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 shows the 13 tasks of RULER from 4k to 10M tokens, grouped into retrieval, tracing, aggregation and question answering. Single-needle retrieval stays at 95 or above for every method up to 5M tokens, except Block Sparse Attention (Tree), which falls to 88 and 71 at 1M tokens. MultiKey 2, MultiKey 3 and CWE fall to at most 5 at 10M tokens for every method, including the baselines, and bound the RULER average of every method. On Qwen-3.8-27B , D-LSA (Flat) exceeds baseline Full Attention at 10M tokens mostly on MultiQuery and HotpotQA, at 92 and 35 against 72 and 20. On GLM-5.3-Flash , D-LSA (Tree) falls to 60, 56 and 55 on MultiKey 1, MultiValue and VT at 10M tokens, against 100 for baseline sparse attention, and these three tasks account for most of its gap to D-LSA (Flat).
paragraphs.zh: 图 11 展示了 RULER 从 4k 到 10M token 的 13 项任务，分为检索、追踪、聚合和问答四类。 在 5M token 以内，除 Block Sparse Attention（Tree）在 1M token 时降至 88 和 71 外，所有方法的单针检索都保持在 95 或以上。 在 10M token 时，包括基线在内的所有方法的 MultiKey 2、MultiKey 3 和 CWE 至多降至 5，并限制了各方法的 RULER 平均分。 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，D-LSA（Flat）在 10M token 时对基线 Full Attention 的超越主要体现在 MultiQuery 和 HotpotQA 上，分别为 92 和 35，而基线为 72 和 20。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，D-LSA（Tree）在 10M token 时的 MultiKey 1、MultiValue 和 VT 上降至 60、56 和 55，而基线稀疏注意力为 100，这三项任务构成了它与 D-LSA（Flat）之间差距的大部分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 shows the three tiers of PaperTrail and their average from 512k to 10M tokens. The harder the tier, the earlier it falls. Tier 3 questions fall to at most 19.0 at 10M tokens for every method on both models, while tier 1 questions stay above 90 on GLM-5.3-Flash . On Qwen-3.8-27B , D-LSA exceeds baseline Full Attention from 5M tokens on tier 1 and tier 2 questions, and D-LSA (Flat) reaches 53.3 and 32.2 against 32.2 and 22.2 at 10M tokens. On GLM-5.3-Flash , D-LSA trails baseline sparse attention mostly on tier 3 questions from 2M tokens, and D-LSA (Flat) also on tier 2 questions at 10M tokens, at 56.7 against 76.7.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 展示了 PaperTrail 的三个层级及其从 512k 到 10M token 的平均值。 层级越难，分数下降越早。 在 10M token 时，两个模型上所有方法的第 3 层问题都降至最高 19.0，而第 1 层问题在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上保持在 90 以上。 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，D-LSA 从 5M token 起在第 1 层和第 2 层问题上超过基线全注意力（Full Attention），且在 10M token 时 D-LSA (Flat) 分别达到 53.3 和 32.2，而基线为 32.2 和 22.2。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，D-LSA 从 2M token 起主要在第 3 层问题上落后于基线稀疏注意力，D-LSA (Flat) 在 10M token 时也在第 2 层问题上落后，为 56.7 对 76.7。

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 compares Block Sparse Attention (Tree) with blocks of 8, 16 and 64 keys, all selecting the same number of keys. At short context, every block size matches the baseline. As the context grows, accuracy falls earlier and further the larger the block, on both benchmarks and both models, as a larger block summarises more keys in one score and can hide a single relevant key. Even with blocks of eight keys, the size we use in the main results, the tree baseline trails D-LSA (Flat) at long context.

paragraphs.en: Precision. The KV cache, the index keys and the bucket centroids are in bf16. For the bucket centroids, which every decode step of the flat search reads in full, bf16 halves the bytes of fp32 at little cost to the selection. In an offline study on GLM-5.3-Flash , the bf16 indexer selects roughly 20 of the 4,096 long-range keys of the flat search differently from an fp32 reference, and changes the attention mass that the selected keys cover by less than 0.0001. Bucket centroids in fp8 would halve their bytes again, but would select about six times as many keys differently, so we keep them in bf16. We do not observe similar sensitivity for the node centroids, which we set to fp8 in D-LSA (Tree).
paragraphs.zh: 精度。 KV 缓存、索引键和桶质心均采用 bf16。 对于桶质心——平面检索的每一次解码步骤都会完整读取它们——bf16 相比 fp32 将字节数减半，而对选择结果的代价很小。 在一项针对 GLM-5.3-Flash 的离线研究中，bf16 索引器与 fp32 参考实现相比，在平面检索的 4,096 个长程键中约有 20 个选择不同，且所选键覆盖的注意力质量变化小于 0.0001。 用 fp8 存储桶质心可再将字节数减半，但会导致选择不同的键数量增加约六倍，因此我们仍保留 bf16。 对于节点质心，我们没有观察到类似的敏感性，因此在 D-LSA（树）中将其设为 fp8。

paragraphs.en: We refer to the steps of D-LSA by their badges in Figure 3 , and Figure 15 shows how we implement each of them. We write kernels for three steps of the indexer: clustering, scoring and selection of the buckets, and expansion of the selected buckets into the index lists J i J_{i} . These kernels are written in CuTe DSL, the Python-based domain-specific language of CUTLASS ( Thakkar et al., 2023 ) , to target H200 and B300 specifically. We also keep a Triton ( Tillet et al., 2019 ) version of each kernel, which is not tied to these two GPUs. We give the shapes and times of the kernels on H200, and note where B300 differs. For attention, we rely on pre-existing attention kernels, that attend over the index lists J i J_{i} unchanged. The only exception is CP (Appendix F.2 ), for which we do add an attention kernel.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用图 3 中各步骤的徽标来指代 D-LSA 的步骤，图 15 展示了我们对每个步骤的实现方式。 我们为索引器的三个步骤编写内核：聚类、桶的评分与选择，以及将选中的桶扩展为索引列表 J i J_{i} 。 这些内核使用 CuTe DSL 编写，即 CUTLASS（Thakkar et al., 2023）基于 Python 的领域专用语言，以专门面向 H200 和 B300。 我们还为每个内核保留了 Triton（Tillet et al., 2019）版本，该版本不局限于这两种 GPU。 我们给出各内核在 H200 上的形状和耗时，并注明 B300 上有所不同的地方。 对于注意力机制，我们依赖已有的注意力内核，对索引列表 J i J_{i} 进行注意力计算而不做任何改动。 唯一的例外是 CP（附录 F.2），我们为其额外编写了一个注意力内核。

paragraphs.en: Clustering. The clustering does relatively little work: one Gram matrix per cluster block, over its pooled keys, takes about 0.13 Gflop for a whole chunk, against 5.5 Tflop for the bucket scan at 10M tokens. Ward’s method, however, merges buckets in rounds that run one after the other. Each of these rounds scores every pair of buckets and merges the cheapest mutual pairs (Algorithm 1 , lines 5 - 11 ), until m m buckets remain. The overall runtime of the clustering step is therefore set by the latency of these rounds. Our kernel cuts the time of each round by keeping its data on chip and avoiding round trips to the host between rounds. More precisely, the kernel keeps the state of a cluster block in shared memory for all its rounds, and spreads its search for partners over a thread-block cluster of up to eight streaming multiprocessors (SMs), which exchange their results through distributed shared memory. In D-LSA (Tree), each pairing that forms the node buckets (line 16 ) runs all its rounds in a single launch, whose thread blocks synchronise through counters in high-bandwidth memory (HBM), so the host neither launches nor reads anything between rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 聚类。 聚类本身工作量相对较小：每个聚类块对其池化后的键计算一个 Gram 矩阵，整个块只需约 0.13 Gflop，而在 1000 万 token 规模下，桶扫描需要 5.5 Tflop。 然而，Ward 方法按轮次合并桶，各轮依次运行。 其中每一轮都会为所有桶对打分，并合并代价最低的互配对（算法 1，第 5–11 行），直到剩下 m m 个桶为止。 因此，聚类步骤的总体运行时间由这些轮次的延迟决定。 我们的内核通过将数据保留在片上，并避免各轮之间与主机之间的往返通信，来缩短每一轮的耗时。 更准确地说，该内核将一个聚类块的状态在其所有轮次中保存在共享内存里，并把对配对对象的搜索分散到最多由八个流式多处理器（SM）组成的线程块簇上，这些处理器通过分布式共享内存交换结果。 在 D-LSA（树）中，每个形成节点桶的配对操作（第 16 行）在单次启动中完成其所有轮次，其线程块通过高带宽内存（HBM）中的计数器进行同步，因此主机在各轮之间既不需要启动任何操作，也不需要读取任何内容。

paragraphs.en: Selection by threshold. D-LSA scores an index query q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} against the centroids c b c_{b} of the buckets ℬ i \mathcal{B}_{i} of the cluster blocks before its own, and keeps its top- p p buckets. Over the index queries of a chunk, the scores s i , b = q i ( idx ) ⋅ c b s_{i,b}=q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}\cdot c_{b} form a matrix with one row per query, so we call the scores of query i i its row , in decode as well. The row holds N i = | ℬ i | N_{i}=\lvert\mathcal{B}_{i}\rvert scores, which grows with the position of the query, to about T / n ¯ b T/\bar{n}_{b} at the end of a context of T T tokens. In prefill and in decode alike, many thread blocks compute the scores of a row, each over its own span of the row, so no thread block sees the whole row, and the selection cannot take its top- p p directly. Instead, inspired by Floyd & Rivest (1975) (who select from only the elements between two bounds estimated from a sample), before the scan, we set a threshold θ i \theta_{i} for each query, and a thread block compares each of its scores with θ i \theta_{i} . Then, it appends only the buckets whose score is at or above it to the list L i L_{i} of the query: one comparison per score, without seeing the rest of the row. Only the buckets of L i L_{i} , a small multiple γ ​ p \gamma p of them (see below), are then ranked.

paragraphs.en: Flat prefill. In prefill, the flat search selects the buckets of all the queries of a chunk at once, in one matrix product on tensor cores, whose kernel compares each score with θ i \theta_{i} as soon as the score is computed, without writing it to memory. We first show why the scores are not written, then how the product is spread over the GPU, and then the steps of Algorithm 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 扁平预填充。 在预填充阶段，扁平搜索一次性选取一个数据块中所有查询的桶，在张量核心上进行一次矩阵乘法，其内核在分数计算出来的同时就将其与 θ i \theta_{i} 进行比较，而不会把分数写入内存。 我们首先说明为什么不写入这些分数，然后说明该乘法如何在 GPU 上分布执行，最后介绍算法 3 的步骤。

sents.en: Flat prefill.
sents.zh: 扁平预填充。

sents.en: In prefill, the flat search selects the buckets of all the queries of a chunk at once, in one matrix product on tensor cores, whose kernel compares each score with θ i \theta_{i} as soon as the score is computed, without writing it to memory.
sents.zh: 在预填充阶段，扁平搜索一次性选取一个数据块中所有查询的桶，在张量核心上进行一次矩阵乘法，其内核在分数计算出来的同时就将其与 θ i \theta_{i} 进行比较，而不会把分数写入内存。

sents.en: We first show why the scores are not written, then how the product is spread over the GPU, and then the steps of Algorithm 3 .
sents.zh: 我们首先说明为什么不写入这些分数，然后说明该乘法如何在 GPU 上分布执行，最后介绍算法 3 的步骤。

paragraphs.en: At 10M tokens, computing S S takes F pre F^{\mathrm{pre}} floating-point operations (flop) on at least B read pre B_{\mathrm{read}}^{\mathrm{pre}} bytes of bf16 queries and centroids, and writing it takes B scores pre B_{\mathrm{scores}}^{\mathrm{pre}} bytes in fp32:
paragraphs.zh: 在 1000 万（10M）token 的规模下，计算 S S 至少需要 F pre F^{\mathrm{pre}} 次浮点运算（flop），涉及至少读取 B read pre B_{\mathrm{read}}^{\mathrm{pre}} 字节的 bf16 查询向量和质心数据，而写出结果需要 B scores pre B_{\mathrm{scores}}^{\mathrm{pre}} 字节的 fp32 存储：

paragraphs.en: On an H200, at the peak of its tensor cores, computing S S would take at least F pre / 989 ​ Tflop/s = 5.6 F^{\mathrm{pre}}/989\,\text{Tflop/s}=5.6 ms. If every query and centroid were read from HBM only once, the products would have an arithmetic intensity of F pre / B read pre ≈ 32000 F^{\mathrm{pre}}/B_{\mathrm{read}}^{\mathrm{pre}}\approx 32000 flop/B, two orders of magnitude above the ridge point of the H200. Under this ideal reuse, they can be bound by compute.

paragraphs.en: As in a matrix multiplication (GEMM), the product is tiled (Figure 17 ). A thread block holds a tile of t q = 128 t_{q}=128 index queries in shared memory, and streams the centroids through it in tiles of t b = 64 t_{b}=64 (128 on B300). It computes one t q × t b t_{q}\times t_{b} tile S tile S^{\mathrm{tile}} of S S at a time, on tensor cores, and keeps it on chip. Each thread block takes such a tile of queries and a span of up to 64 tiles of centroids. At 10M tokens, a row is thus split into 320 spans, and the chunk into 256 × 320 = 81920 256\times 320=81920 thread blocks, while an H200 runs 528 at a time, 4 on each of its 132 SMs, which is enough to keep every SM busy. At shorter contexts, the spans shrink, so that there are still enough thread blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 如同矩阵乘法（GEMM）一样，乘积被分块处理（图 17）。 一个线程块在共享内存中保存大小为 t q = 128 t_{q}=128 的索引查询块，并以大小为 t b = 64 t_{b}=64 的块（在 B300 上为 128）流式传输质心通过它。 它每次在张量核心上计算 S S 的一个 t q × t b t_{q}\times t_{b} 的块 S tile S^{\mathrm{tile}}，并将其保留在片上。 每个线程块处理这样一个查询块以及最多 64 个质心块的跨度。 在 1000 万 token 时，一行因此被分成 320 个跨度，该 chunk 被分成 256 × 320 = 81920 256\times 320=81920 个线程块，而 H200 一次运行 528 个，其 132 个 SM 上每个运行 4 个，这足以让每个 SM 保持忙碌。 在较短的上下文中，跨度会缩小，因此仍然有足够的线程块。

paragraphs.en: The bucket scan differs from a GEMM only in its epilogue. Instead of writing each entry S i , b S_{i,b} of S tile S^{\mathrm{tile}} , the epilogue compares it with the threshold (lines 6 - 7 ), and compacts the buckets at or above it in shared memory, so that each span appends them to L i L_{i} in HBM with one atomic per query (line 9 ). With d ( idx ) = 64 d^{(\mathrm{idx})}=64 , a tile takes few products, and this epilogue costs about as much as they do, so the two must overlap. On H200, the thread block splits its warps by role: one warp loads the tiles of centroids into shared memory with the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), in a pipeline of two stages, while a warpgroup multiplies them on tensor cores (WGMMA) into two accumulators in registers, and compares one with the threshold while the tensor cores fill the other. On B300, the products accumulate in the tensor memory of the SM instead, from which the comparing threads load them. Triton emits the same instructions, but chooses this schedule itself and gives no control of shared memory, which is why we write the scan in CuTe DSL.
paragraphs.zh: 桶扫描与 GEMM 的区别仅在于其收尾阶段（epilogue）。 收尾阶段不写出 S 磁贴 S^{\mathrm{tile}} 中的每个条目 S_{i,b}，而是将其与阈值进行比较（第 6–7 行），并在共享内存中压缩达到或超过阈值的桶，使每个 span 以每查询一次原子操作的方式将它们追加到 HBM 中的 L_{i}（第 9 行）。 当 d^{(\mathrm{idx})}=64 时，一个磁贴只需做少量乘积，而此收尾阶段的开销与这些乘积大致相当，因此两者必须重叠执行。 在 H200 上，线程块按角色划分其 warp：一个 warp 使用张量内存加速器（TMA）以两级流水线的方式将质心磁贴加载到共享内存中，同时一个 warpgroup 在张量核上用 WGMMA 将它们乘入寄存器中的两个累加器，并在张量核填充另一个累加器的同时，将其中一个与阈值进行比较。 在 B300 上，乘积改为累加在 SM 的张量内存中，比较线程从那里加载它们。 Triton 会生成相同的指令，但它自行选择调度方式且不提供对共享内存的控制，这正是我们用 CuTe DSL 编写该扫描的原因。

paragraphs.en: CUDA graphs. A prefill chunk takes milliseconds, against which the launches of its kernels from the host cost little, and its selection reads the sizes of its lists back on the host, so we serve prefill without graphs. A decode step of the selection, however, takes only tens of microseconds, about as long as its launches, so SGLang captures each decode step, our kernels included, in a CUDA graph, and replays it with one launch from the host. A CUDA graph fixes the shapes of its kernels, so a graph sized for the longest context the server admits would launch the thread blocks of 10M tokens at every step, whatever the contexts of the batch. The factor 1.125 avoids this for the common case: a request of a power-of-two length, with its answer, sits at about 89% of its range. paragraphs.en: Its arithmetic intensity F dec / B read dec ≈ 1 F^{\mathrm{dec}}/B_{\mathrm{read}}^{\mathrm{dec}}\approx 1 flop/B is far below the ridge point: the selection is bound by memory, and reading the centroids once would take at least B read dec / 4.8 ​ TB/s = 35 B_{\mathrm{read}}^{\mathrm{dec}}/4.8\,\text{TB/s}=35 µs on H200. Prefill, bound by compute, can afford to read the centroids more than once: every tile of queries reads them all, and candidate scoring reads those of L i L_{i} again. sents.en: Programmatic dependent launch ( NVIDIA, 2026f ) , a feature of Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, lets a kernel start while the one before it still runs, and wait for its results only where it reads them (line 5 ).
sents.zh: 程序化依赖启动（ NVIDIA, 2026f ）是 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 的一项特性，它允许一个内核在前一个内核仍在运行时启动，并仅在其读取结果之处等待前一个内核的结果（第 5 行）。

sents.en: The scan thus reads and scores the centroids while θ i \theta_{i} is still being computed.
sents.zh: 因此，扫描在 θ i \theta_{i} 仍在计算的同时读取质心并对其打分。

paragraphs.en: Tree prefill. In prefill, the beam search (Algorithm 2 ) starts at the lowest level with at most n start = 32768 n_{\mathrm{start}}=32768 node buckets, a value we chose by a sweep of accuracy against time. It keeps a beam of p ℓ = 2048 p_{\ell}=2048 node buckets on every level. The descent starts from every node bucket of this level (line 1 ), which one matrix product in cuBLAS scores in full. Each level of the descent (lines 2 - 7 ) then runs in one kernel (five or six launches in Triton), besides a matrix product in cuBLAS that scores the open node buckets of the level. In this kernel, a thread block holds the scores of one query in shared memory, one 32-bit word per candidate, up to the 227 KiB a thread block can take. It scores the children of the node buckets kept on the level above (line 3 ). It then finds the p ℓ p_{\ell} -th score by a radix select of four passes, each of which counts one byte of the words in a histogram of 256 bins (line 4 ). Finally, it writes the children of the node buckets it keeps as the candidates C C of the next level (line 5 ). Above about 24k node buckets, keeping the beam of the start level this way would leave a single thread block per SM, so it takes two launches instead: a listing of the node buckets above a sampled threshold, as in the flat search, and the keep of the beam. At level 0 (lines 8 - 9 ), the thread block writes the top- p p buckets as packed scores σ i , b \sigma_{i,b} . The expansion of Algorithm 3 (lines 13 - 16 ) reads them as it reads L i L_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 树预填充。 在预填充中，束搜索（算法 2）从最低层开始，使用至多 n_start=32768 个节点桶，该数值是我们在准确率与时间之间进行权衡扫描后选定的。 它在每一层保留 p_ℓ=2048 个节点桶的束。 下降从该层的每个节点桶开始（第 1 行），由 cuBLAS 中的一次矩阵乘积完整打分。 下降的每一层（第 2–7 行）随后在一个内核中运行（在 Triton 中为五或六次启动），此外还需在 cuBLAS 中进行一次矩阵乘积，为该层开放节点桶打分。 在该内核中，一个线程块将一个查询的分数保存在共享内存中，每个候选一个 32 位字，直至线程块可容纳的 227 KiB 上限。 它为上一层保留的节点桶的子节点打分（第 3 行）。 然后它通过四次遍历的基数选择找出第 p_ℓ 个分数，每次遍历在 256 个桶的直方图中统计这些字的一个字节（第 4 行）。 最后，它将保留的节点桶的子节点作为下一层的候选 C 写出（第 5 行）。 在约 24k 个节点桶以上，以这种方式保留起始层的束会使每个 SM 只剩一个线程块，因此改为两次启动：如扁平搜索那样列出高于采样阈值的节点桶，以及保留束。 在第 0 层（第 8–9 行），线程块将前 p 个桶写为打包分数 σ_{i,b}。 算法 3 的扩展（第 13–16 行）读取它们的方式与读取 L_i 相同。

paragraphs.en: Tree decode. In decode, the new queries of all the requests of a batch descend together, through the beam kernels of the prefill, but over a copy of the hierarchy at fixed addresses, and at shapes set by the longest context, so that a CUDA graph can replay the step. Each request adds one query per step, but the descent still runs its levels one after another, so its time barely changes with the number of requests, while the flat search scans every bucket once per request. Every query scores the levels from the top level of the longest context down, and holds no candidates above its own start level. A step takes 7 to 13 kernels from 128k to 10M tokens, as the number of levels grows with the context.
paragraphs.zh: 树解码。 在解码中，一个批次中所有请求的新查询一起下行，穿过与预填充相同的束内核，但作用于层级结构在固定地址上的一份副本，并且形状由最长上下文决定，以便 CUDA 图可以重放该步骤。 每个请求在每一步只增加一个查询，但下行仍然逐层依次进行，因此其耗时几乎不随请求数量变化，而平面搜索则每处理一个请求就要扫描一遍每个桶。 每个查询从最长上下文的顶层开始向下对各级评分，并且在其自身起始层级之上不保留任何候选。 从 128k 到 10M token，一步需要 7 到 13 个内核，因为层级数量随上下文增长。

paragraphs.en: Other steps. The remaining steps of D-LSA are the projections and the L2 normalisation of the index keys k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} and queries q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , the pooling, and the tables of B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} . They consist of matrix products, reductions and a sort, which run as standard PyTorch operations, with the products through cuBLAS. These steps cost little next to the scoring. On GLM-5.3-Flash , for example, each of the two projections of a chunk of 32,768 tokens from the 512 dimensions of the latent takes 2 ⋅ 32768 ⋅ 512 ⋅ 64 2\cdot 32768\cdot 512\cdot 64 flop, 4.3 Gflop for both. This is under 1% of the scoring of the chunk at contexts of 1M tokens and beyond (Equation 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 其他步骤。 D-LSA 的其余步骤是对索引键 k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 和查询 q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 的投影与 L2 归一化、池化，以及 B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 的各个表。 它们由矩阵乘法、规约和一次排序组成，均以标准 PyTorch 操作运行，其中矩阵乘法通过 cuBLAS 执行。 与评分相比，这些步骤的代价微不足道。 以 GLM-5.3-Flash 为例，对每块 32,768 个词元从 512 维潜在维度进行的两次投影，每次需要 2 ⋅ 32768 ⋅ 512 ⋅ 64 2\cdot 32768\cdot 512\cdot 64 flop，两次共 4.3 Gflop。 在 1M 词元及以上的上下文长度下，这只占该块评分成本的不到 1%（公式 6）。

paragraphs.en: Attention kernels. D-LSA attends through existing kernels, which only need to read the index lists in a layout of their own. The expansion writes the index list J i J_{i} of every query i i as a row of n sink + k + n w = 4612 n_{\mathrm{sink}}+k+n_{w}=4612 int32 entries. Each entry is the slot in the KV cache of one key j ∈ J i j\in J_{i} , and the row is padded with − 1 -1 when the query has fewer keys to attend to. The index lists of a chunk 𝒞 \mathcal{C} thus form one matrix of | 𝒞 | \lvert\mathcal{C}\rvert rows. On GLM-5.3-Flash , J i J_{i} takes the place of the index list of the model’s own indexer, and the sparse attention of SGLang attends over it unchanged. On Qwen-3.8-27B , we pass every query i i to a paged attention kernel as a sequence of its own: its row is the page table, each page holds one slot, and the sequence length is | J i | \lvert J_{i}\rvert . Table 10 lists the attention kernels we use, from FlashAttention-3 (FA3) ( Shah et al., 2024 ) and its successor FA4, FlashMLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) , the TRT-LLM kernels of FlashInfer ( Ye et al., 2025 ) and Triton. Each is the default of SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) for its model and GPU, except where that default cannot run. For instance, on B300, D-LSA on Qwen-3.8-27B attends through the Triton kernel of SGLang, as FlashAttention supports pages of a single slot only on Hopper. With CP8, GLM-5.3-Flash decodes through a split-KV sparse kernel that we add to SGLang (Appendix F.2 ), and on B300 it prefills through a TileLang kernel ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . With decode context parallelism (DCP8, Appendix F.2 ) on H200, Full Attention and Block Sparse Attention (Flat) on Qwen-3.8-27B decode through Triton kernels.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力内核。 D-LSA 通过现有内核进行注意力计算，这些内核只需按照各自特有的布局读取索引列表。 扩展过程把每个查询 i i 的索引列表 J i J_{i} 写成一行 n sink + k + n w = 4612 n_{\mathrm{sink}}+k+n_{w}=4612 个 int32 条目。 每个条目是某个键 j ∈ J i j\in J_{i} 在 KV 缓存中的槽位，当查询需要关注的键较少时，该行用 − 1 -1 填充。 一个分块 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 的索引列表由此构成一个包含 | 𝒞 | \lvert\mathcal{C}\rvert 行的矩阵。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上， J i J_{i} 取代了模型自身索引器的索引列表，SGLang 的稀疏注意力无需改动即可在其上进行注意力计算。 在 Qwen-3.8-27B 上，我们把每个查询 i i 作为一个独立序列传给分页注意力内核：该行即为页表，每页持有一个槽位，序列长度为 | J i | \lvert J_{i}\rvert 。 表 10 列出了我们使用的注意力内核，包括 FlashAttention-3（FA3）（ Shah et al., 2024 ）及其后继 FA4、FlashMLA（ Li et al., 2025 ）、FlashInfer 的 TRT-LLM 内核（ Ye et al., 2025 ）以及 Triton。 除默认内核无法运行的情况外，每种内核都是 SGLang（ Zheng et al., 2024 ）针对相应模型和 GPU 的默认选择。 例如，在 B300 上，Qwen-3.8-27B 的 D-LSA 通过 SGLang 的 Triton 内核进行注意力计算，因为 FlashAttention 仅在 Hopper 上支持单槽位的页。 在 CP8 配置下，GLM-5.3-Flash 通过我们添加到 SGLang 的 split-KV 稀疏内核进行解码（附录 F.2 ），并在 B300 上通过 TileLang 内核（ Wang et al., 2025 ）进行预填充。 在 H200 上启用解码上下文并行（DCP8，附录 F.2 ）时，Qwen-3.8-27B 的全注意力与块稀疏注意力（Flat）通过 Triton 内核进行解码。

paragraphs.en: N-LSA training. The kernels above serve D-LSA at inference. N-LSA also needs kernels for training, for its forward and its backward pass, with which a layer is up to 1.6 × \times faster than with Full Attention at 128k tokens (Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: N-LSA 的训练。 上述内核用于 D-LSA 的推理。 N-LSA 还需要用于训练的内核，包括其前向传播和反向传播，借助这些内核，在 128k token 下一个层的速度最高可达到全注意力（Full Attention）的 1.6 × \times 倍（第 4.4 节）。

sents.zh: N-LSA 还需要用于训练的内核，包括其前向传播和反向传播，借助这些内核，在 128k token 下一个层的速度最高可达到全注意力（Full Attention）的 1.6 × \times 倍（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: A few changes stem from the architectural differences of N-LSA compared to D-LSA. A training step processes whole sequences, of up to 128k tokens in our runs, with no KV cache and no decode, so every query of a sequence selects at once, as in a prefill chunk as long as the sequence. The keys change at every step as the attention projections learn, so every step clusters all keys again, where D-LSA clusters each cluster block once and keeps its buckets in the cache. The selection clusters and scores the attention’s own normalised keys and queries, of dimension 128, and takes the best score of the 8 query heads (Equation 3 ). At 128k tokens, a row holds at most 16,384 buckets, from which a query selects p = 512 p=512 for k = 2048 k=2048 keys, next to a window of 512 keys and 4 sink keys. Finally, every step runs a backward pass, which D-LSA never does at long context.
paragraphs.zh: 一些改动源于 N-LSA 与 D-LSA 在架构上的差异。 训练步骤一次性处理整条序列（在我们的运行中最长可达 128k token），没有 KV 缓存也没有解码，因此序列中的每个查询会像与整条序列等长的预填充分块那样一次性完成选择。 由于注意力投影在学习，键在每一步都会变化，因此每一步都要重新对所有键进行聚类，而 D-LSA 只对每个聚类块聚类一次并把其桶保存在缓存中。 选择机制对注意力自身归一化后的键和查询（维度为 128）进行聚类和打分，并取 8 个查询头中的最高分（公式 3）。 在 128k token 时，一行最多包含 16,384 个桶，查询从中选出 p = 512 p=512 个桶以得到 k = 2048 k=2048 个键，此外还有一个 512 个键的窗口和 4 个汇聚（sink）键。 最后，每一步都会运行一次反向传播，而 D-LSA 在长上下文中从不这样做。

paragraphs.en: Two of these differences shape the kernels. As the rows are short, the selection places θ i \theta_{i} from the whole row rather than from a sample: a first pass over the row counts its scores in a histogram of 256 bins, and a second lists the buckets from the bin of the p p -th score up, both on tensor cores, and the top- p p of the list are then taken by their scores. The backward pass is the main addition. As N-LSA stops the gradient through the selection, the clustering and the scoring of the centroids need no backward pass, and the only new backward kernel is that of the sparse attention. For one query head, with logits z i , j = q i ⋅ k j / d h z_{i,j}=q_{i}\cdot k_{j}/\sqrt{d_{h}} , its forward pass, as in any attention kernel, runs over the queries, each query i i attending to the keys it selected and writing only its own output:
paragraphs.zh: 这些差异中有两点塑造了内核。 由于行较短，选择操作 θ i \theta_{i} 从整行而非从采样中进行：第一遍对该行的分数在 256 个桶的直方图中计数，第二遍从第 p p 个分数所在的桶起列出各桶，两者都在张量核心上执行，然后取列表中按分数排名的前 p p 项。 反向传播是主要的新增部分。 由于 N-LSA 在选择处截断了梯度，聚类和质心评分不需要反向传播，唯一新增的反向内核是稀疏注意力。 对于一个查询头，其 logit 为 z i , j = q i ⋅ k j / d h z_{i,j}=q_{i}\cdot k_{j}/\sqrt{d_{h}} ，它的前向传播如同任何注意力内核一样遍历各查询，每个查询 i i 关注它选中的键并只写出自己的输出：

paragraphs.zh: 它的反向传播无法以同样的方式在查询上运行，因为每个键 j j 及其值都会从每一个选中该键的查询那里接收 NTP 损失 ℒ \mathcal{L} 的梯度：

paragraphs.en: where I j = { i : j ∈ J i } I_{j}=\{\,i:j\in J_{i}\,\} , and the queries of I j I_{j} lie anywhere in the sequence at or after j j . As the 8 query heads share one key-value head, ∂ ℒ / ∂ k j \partial\mathcal{L}/\partial k_{j} and ∂ ℒ / ∂ v j \partial\mathcal{L}/\partial v_{j} also sum over the heads. Run over the queries, the backward pass would have many thread blocks add into the gradient of the same key, with an atomic addition for each share. The backward kernels instead run over the keys, as the backward pass of FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) does for dense attention (Algorithm 5 ). With a sparse selection, this first requires inverting the selection, listing the queries of each group of keys (lines 1 - 2 ). A thread block then holds the gradients of a group of keys in registers, adds the shares of these queries into them (lines 4 - 9 ), and writes them with few atomic additions (line 11 ). The gradient of each query sums over its own J i J_{i} , so a separate pass gathers it as in the forward pass, computing ∂ ℒ / ∂ z i , j \partial\mathcal{L}/\partial z_{i,j} again (line 12 ). paragraphs.en: Measurements. Table 11 times each step on one H200 with Nsight Compute, in a single profile with the clocks unlocked, with its CuTe DSL and its Triton kernels. The inputs are synthetic, at the shapes we serve: a prefill chunk of 32,768 queries at 10M tokens, a beam of p ℓ = 2048 p_{\ell}=2048 over node buckets of n b , ℓ = 4 n_{b,\ell}=4 , decode with one request at 10M tokens, the Ward clustering of the 64 cluster blocks of one prefill chunk, and the clustering of one node block of n cluster , ℓ = 4096 n_{\mathrm{cluster},\ell}=4096 buckets into node buckets. The times are those of the kernels alone, without the PyTorch launches between them. The regime of a step is where its main CuTe DSL kernel sits: bound by compute or by memory, with its share of the bf16 peak or of the HBM bandwidth of Table 9 , bound by neither as a radix select over packed integer keys (selection), or limited by its serial rounds (latency). The bucket scan, the largest step of the flat prefill, reaches 49% of the bf16 peak and uses 1% of the HBM bandwidth, so the tiles of queries reread the centroids mostly from the L2 cache. On real inputs, the index queries of 12 held-out documents of 1M tokens and 3 books of 10M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash , over all its sparse layers, L i L_{i} holds 1,679 buckets on average at 1M tokens and 1,737 at 10M, never overflows, and falls back, with fewer than p p buckets above θ i \theta_{i} , for 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} of the queries at 1M and 10 − 3 10^{-3} at 10M. In decode, 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} of the steps fall back at 1M, mostly as their lists overflow, and none at 10M. The decode scan reads at 3.58 TB/s, 75% of the HBM bandwidth. At 10M tokens, the CuTe DSL kernels are faster than the Triton ones in every step, from 1.02 × \times for candidate scoring, which is bound by the HBM bandwidth in both languages, to 4.4 × \times for the threshold estimate. On B300, they are faster by up to 4.3 × \times in every step but level 0 of the tree search, where the two languages tie. Of the 22 ms that CuTe DSL saves on a prefill chunk at 10M tokens, 13.4 ms come from the bucket scan, mostly from overlapping its epilogue with its products, and 6.8 ms from the threshold estimate, whose Triton version writes the scores of its sample to HBM and reads them twice.
paragraphs.zh: 测量。 表 11 在一块 H200 上用 Nsight Compute 对每一步计时，时钟未锁定，在单次剖析中完成，使用其 CuTe DSL 内核与 Triton 内核。 输入是合成的，采用我们实际服务的形状：在 10M token 下一个包含 32,768 个查询的预填充块，在节点桶 n b , ℓ = 4 n_{b,\ell}=4 上的一个宽度为 p ℓ = 2048 p_{\ell}=2048 的束搜索，在 10M token 下对一个请求进行解码，一个预填充块 64 个聚类块的 Ward 聚类，以及把一个含 n cluster , ℓ = 4096 n_{\mathrm{cluster},\ell}=4096 个桶的节点块聚类为节点桶。 所计时间是各内核本身的时间，不含其间的 PyTorch 启动开销。 每一步的运行状态取决于其主 CuTe DSL 内核所处的情形：受算力或内存带宽限制（对应表 9 中 bf16 峰值算力或 HBM 带宽的相应份额），两者皆不受限（如对打包整数键做基数选择的选择操作），或受其串行轮次限制（延迟型）。 桶扫描是扁平预填充中最大的一步，达到 bf16 峰值的 49%，仅使用 HBM 带宽的 1%，因此查询分块主要从 L2 缓存重读质心。 在真实输入上，对 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 12 篇各 1M token 的留出文档和 3 本各 10M token 的书籍，在其所有稀疏层上进行索引查询：L i L_{i} 在 1M token 下平均持有 1,679 个桶，在 10M token 下为 1,737 个，从不溢出；当高于 θ i \theta_{i} 的桶数少于 p p 时发生回退，回退比例在 1M token 下为查询的 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5}，在 10M token 下为 10 − 3 10^{-3}。 在解码中，1M token 下有 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} 的步骤发生回退，大多因其列表溢出；10M token 下则没有。 解码扫描的读取速度为 3.58 TB/s，即 HBM 带宽的 75%。 在 10M token 下，CuTe DSL 内核在每一步都快于 Triton 内核，从候选打分的 1.02 × \times（两种语言下均受 HBM 带宽限制）到阈值估计的 4.4 × \times 不等。 在 B300 上，除树搜索的第 0 层（两种语言打平）外，它们在每一步都快至多 4.3 × \times。 在 10M token 下对一个预填充块，CuTe DSL 共节省 22 ms，其中 13.4 ms 来自桶扫描（主要来自将其尾声与其他乘积计算重叠），6.8 ms 来自阈值估计（其 Triton 版本需把样本的得分写入 HBM 并读取两次）。

sents.en: On real inputs, the index queries of 12 held-out documents of 1M tokens and 3 books of 10M tokens on GLM-5.3-Flash , over all its sparse layers, L i L_{i} holds 1,679 buckets on average at 1M tokens and 1,737 at 10M, never overflows, and falls back, with fewer than p p buckets above θ i \theta_{i} , for 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} of the queries at 1M and 10 − 3 10^{-3} at 10M.
sents.zh: 在真实输入上，对 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 12 篇各 1M token 的留出文档和 3 本各 10M token 的书籍，在其所有稀疏层上进行索引查询：L i L_{i} 在 1M token 下平均持有 1,679 个桶，在 10M token 下为 1,737 个，从不溢出；当高于 θ i \theta_{i} 的桶数少于 p p 时发生回退，回退比例在 1M token 下为查询的 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5}，在 10M token 下为 10 − 3 10^{-3}。

sents.en: In decode, 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} of the steps fall back at 1M, mostly as their lists overflow, and none at 10M.
sents.zh: 在解码中，1M token 下有 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} 的步骤发生回退，大多因其列表溢出；10M token 下则没有。

sents.en: The decode scan reads at 3.58 TB/s, 75% of the HBM bandwidth.
sents.zh: 解码扫描的读取速度为 3.58 TB/s，即 HBM 带宽的 75%。

sents.en: At 10M tokens, the CuTe DSL kernels are faster than the Triton ones in every step, from 1.02 × \times for candidate scoring, which is bound by the HBM bandwidth in both languages, to 4.4 × \times for the threshold estimate.
sents.zh: 在 10M token 下，CuTe DSL 内核在每一步都快于 Triton 内核，从候选打分的 1.02 × \times（两种语言下均受 HBM 带宽限制）到阈值估计的 4.4 × \times 不等。

sents.en: On B300, they are faster by up to 4.3 × \times in every step but level 0 of the tree search, where the two languages tie.
sents.zh: 在 B300 上，除树搜索的第 0 层（两种语言打平）外，它们在每一步都快至多 4.3 × \times。

sents.en: Of the 22 ms that CuTe DSL saves on a prefill chunk at 10M tokens, 13.4 ms come from the bucket scan, mostly from overlapping its epilogue with its products, and 6.8 ms from the threshold estimate, whose Triton version writes the scores of its sample to HBM and reads them twice.
sents.zh: 在 10M token 下对一个预填充块，CuTe DSL 共节省 22 ms，其中 13.4 ms 来自桶扫描（主要来自将其尾声与其他乘积计算重叠），6.8 ms 来自阈值估计（其 Triton 版本需把样本的得分写入 HBM 并读取两次）。

paragraphs.en: The Triton versions of other steps take more launches or more passes: the node-bucket clustering takes three launches per round and reads two flags on the host every eight rounds (3.4 × \times ), and the expansion finds its cut one bit per pass rather than one byte (1.75 × \times ). Table 11 sums the kernel times of the four launches of the decode select (the sample, the threshold, the scan and the listing), 71 µs at 10M tokens. Replayed from a CUDA graph, where programmatic dependent launch overlaps them, they take 14.7 µs at 1M tokens and 60.7 µs at 10M, against 36.4 µs and 146.6 µs in Triton. With the expansion and the other kernels of the selection, a flat decode step selects in 35 µs at 1M tokens and 86 µs at 10M, and Table 12 compares it with the tree search. With one request, the flat search is faster up to about 5M tokens. With 4 and 16 requests, the tree search is faster from about 1M and 256k tokens, and with 16 requests it is 5.6 × \times faster at 10M tokens. As we evaluate one request at a time, every result of D-LSA (Tree) decodes with the flat search, and only its prefill uses the tree. At 1M tokens, the four steps of the flat prefill take 5.2 ms in CuTe DSL against 9.4 ms in Triton. For a whole layer of GLM-5.3-Flash on H200, CuTe DSL makes a prefill chunk at 10M tokens 1.35 × \times faster than Triton.

paragraphs.en: LSA is orthogonal to expert and pipeline parallelism: the former splits only the experts, and the latter keeps the index of a layer co-located with its attention on the same rank, so in this section we do not describe these two mesh configurations, but focus on TP and CP instead.

sents.zh: 使用 MLA 时，秩可以从其 KV 缓存中的潜在表示 k_{j}^{(\mathrm{attn})} 重新计算它们，因此无需存储。

sents.en: With GQA, a rank holds only some KV heads, so it cannot recompute them alone.
sents.zh: 使用 GQA 时，秩只持有部分 KV 头，因此无法单独重新计算它们。

sents.en: Instead, it stores k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} once summed: the AllReduce of Equation 13 carries the partial key k j , r ( idx ) k_{j,r}^{(\mathrm{idx})} of a token together with the token’s own partial query, so storing it costs memory, 2 ​ d ( idx ) = 128 2d^{(\mathrm{idx})}=128 B per token, but no communication.
sents.zh: 相反，它在求和后存储一次 k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})}：公式 13 的 AllReduce 会将某个 token 的部分键 k_{j,r}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 与该 token 自身的部分查询一起传输，因此存储它需要占用每个 token 2d^{(\mathrm{idx})}=128 B 的内存，但无需额外通信。

sents.en: Recomputing it would save that memory, at the cost of a second AllReduce of the fp32 partial keys, 256 B per token, once each block is complete.
sents.zh: 重新计算它可以节省这部分内存，但代价是每当某个块完成时，需要对 fp32 部分键进行第二次 AllReduce，每个 token 为 256 B。

paragraphs.en: With MLA, the AllReduce carries the 512 dimensions of the latent, 2 KiB. Since the KV cache is replicated, B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} adds the same 24.5 B per token to the 1 KiB of KV cache as without parallelism.

paragraphs.en: Context parallelism. CP splits work by token in two ways ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) , which we describe in the following, and illustrate in Figure 19 .
paragraphs.zh: 上下文并行。 CP 以两种方式按 token 划分工作（Liu et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025a），我们将在下文中描述，并在图 19 中加以说明。

sents.en: Context parallelism.
sents.zh: 上下文并行。

sents.en: CP splits work by token in two ways ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) , which we describe in the following, and illustrate in Figure 19 .
sents.zh: CP 以两种方式按 token 划分工作（Liu et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025a），我们将在下文中描述，并在图 19 中加以说明。

paragraphs.en: Decode context parallelism (DCP), also called KV parallelism ( Bhatia et al., 2025 ) , splits the KV cache across the ranks, in both prefill and decode, so that each rank stores only 1 / N 1/N of it, which lets a context of millions of tokens fit in HBM, and reads only its share in each decode step. SGLang deals the tokens out round-robin: token j j goes to rank r j r_{j} , its slot in the KV cache modulo N N , and that rank holds key k j k_{j} and thus computes index key k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} .
paragraphs.zh: 解码上下文并行（DCP），也称为 KV 并行（Bhatia et al., 2025），在 prefill 和 decode 阶段都将 KV 缓存切分到各个 rank 上，使每个 rank 只存储其中的 1 / N 1/N，从而让数百万 token 的上下文能够装入 HBM，并在每个 decode 步骤中只读取自己所负责的那部分。 SGLang 以轮询方式分配 token：token j j 被分配到 rank r j r_{j}，即它在 KV 缓存中对 N N 取模的槽位，该 rank 保存键 k j k_{j} 并因此计算索引键 k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})}。

sents.en: SGLang deals the tokens out round-robin: token j j goes to rank r j r_{j} , its slot in the KV cache modulo N N , and that rank holds key k j k_{j} and thus computes index key k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} .
sents.zh: SGLang 以轮询方式分配 token：token j j 被分配到 rank r j r_{j}，即它在 KV 缓存中对 N N 取模的槽位，该 rank 保存键 k j k_{j} 并因此计算索引键 k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})}。

paragraphs.en: Prefill context parallelism (PCP) also splits the query rows of a chunk 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , giving rank r r the rows 𝒞 r \mathcal{C}_{r} , so that it selects the index lists J i J_{i} of its own rows i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} only. The index query is not split: with PCP, every rank holds in prefill all n h n_{h} query heads q i , h ( attn ) q_{i,h}^{(\mathrm{attn})} of its rows, and in decode (and with GQA also in prefill), the ranks gather them, as the attention does anyway, so every rank computes q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} itself.
paragraphs.zh: 预填充上下文并行（PCP）同样会对块 𝒞 的查询行进行切分，把行 𝒞_r 分给秩 r，使得它只为自己所拥有的行 i ∈ 𝒞_r 选择索引列表 J_i。 索引查询不做切分：在 PCP 下，每个秩在预填充阶段持有其所有行的全部 n_h 个查询头 q_{i,h}^{(attn)}；而在解码阶段（以及在 GQA 下也包括预填充阶段），各秩会像注意力机制本来就要做的那样对它们进行收集，因此每个秩都能自行计算 q_i^{(idx)}。

sents.zh: 预填充上下文并行（PCP）同样会对块 𝒞 的查询行进行切分，把行 𝒞_r 分给秩 r，使得它只为自己所拥有的行 i ∈ 𝒞_r 选择索引列表 J_i。

paragraphs.en: We extend SGLang with PCP for GLM-5.3-Flash , which leaves us free to choose its layout, for both the base model and LSA. We make each 𝒞 r \mathcal{C}_{r} one contiguous span of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , which lets the linear-attention layers pass their recurrent state along it. LSA does not depend on this split, but it is a natural fit: as every query attends a fixed budget of keys, a contiguous split already balances the sparse attention across ranks, whereas dense causal attention commonly uses a zigzag or striped split to balance its causal work ( Brandon et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 SGLang 中扩展实现了 PCP，这使我们能够自由选择其布局，适用于基础模型和 LSA。 我们让每个 𝒞 r \mathcal{C}_{r} 成为 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 中的一个连续片段，这使得线性注意力层能够沿其传递循环状态。 LSA 并不依赖于这种切分，但它是一种自然的契合：由于每个查询只关注固定预算的键，连续切分已经能在各 rank 之间平衡稀疏注意力，而稠密因果注意力通常采用之字形（zigzag）或条纹（striped）切分来平衡其因果计算量（Brandon et al., 2023；Yang et al., 2025a）。

sents.zh: 我们为 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 SGLang 中扩展实现了 PCP，这使我们能够自由选择其布局，适用于基础模型和 LSA。

paragraphs.en: With MLA, we use both PCP and DCP (Figure 19 , top), with no TP in the prefill attention, since SGLang was already developing PCP for GLM-5.3-Flash , while it had none for Qwen-3.8-27B . This also suits LSA: PCP splits the prefill by query rows rather than by heads. Every rank thus holds all query heads of its rows and computes their index queries q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})} , i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} , alone, without the AllReduce of Equation 13 that TP needs. For PCP, the attention already gathers the latents K 𝒞 ( attn ) K_{\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{attn})} of the whole chunk. Every rank thus projects the index keys K 𝒞 ( idx ) K_{\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} of the whole chunk itself, and clusters them into the same B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} . The indexer thus adds no communication, as long as each chunk starts on a cluster block, as chunks of 32768 = 64 ​ n cluster 32768=64\,n_{\mathrm{cluster}} tokens do. Each rank selects J i J_{i} for its rows i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} , but DCP splits the KV cache of the prefix across ranks, so most of the selected keys j ∈ J i j\in J_{i} live on other ranks, r j ≠ r r_{j}\neq r . The sparse attention, of the base model as of LSA, gathers only those rows. Every rank marks the prefix rows that its lists J i J_{i} , i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} , select in a mask J 𝒞 r J_{\mathcal{C}_{r}} of one byte per prefix row, and one AllReduce with the maximum gives every rank their union J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} over the chunk, less the chunk itself, whose rows every rank already holds:
paragraphs.zh: 在 MLA 下，我们同时使用 PCP 和 DCP（图 19 上方），在预填充注意力中不使用 TP，因为 SGLang 已经在为 GLM-5.3-Flash 开发 PCP，而对 Qwen-3.8-27B 则没有。 这也契合 LSA：PCP 按查询行而非按注意力头切分预填充。 因此每个秩（rank）持有其各行的全部查询头，并独立计算它们的索引查询 q i ( idx ) q_{i}^{(\mathrm{idx})}（i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r}），无需 TP 所需的公式 13 中的 AllReduce。 对于 PCP，注意力机制已经收集了整个块的潜向量 K 𝒞 ( attn ) K_{\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{attn})}。 因此每个秩自行投影整个块的索引键 K 𝒞 ( idx ) K_{\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{idx})}，并将它们聚类到相同的 B cache ( idx ) B_{\mathrm{cache}}^{(\mathrm{idx})} 中。 只要每个块都从簇块边界开始（例如 32768 = 64 ​ n cluster 32768=64\,n_{\mathrm{cluster}} 个词元的块），索引器就无需任何通信。 每个秩为其行 i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} 选择 J i J_{i}，但 DCP 将前缀的 KV 缓存切分到各秩上，因此所选的大部分键 j ∈ J i j\in J_{i} 位于其他秩上，即 r j ≠ r r_{j}\neq r。 无论是基础模型还是 LSA，稀疏注意力都只收集这些行。 每个秩在其列表 J i J_{i}（i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r}）所选的前缀行上做标记，生成每个前缀行占一个字节的掩码 J 𝒞 r J_{\mathcal{C}_{r}}，一次取最大值的 AllReduce 即可让每个秩得到整个块上的并集 J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}}，减去块本身——其各行每个秩都已持有：

sents.zh: 在 MLA 下，我们同时使用 PCP 和 DCP（图 19 上方），在预填充注意力中不使用 TP，因为 SGLang 已经在为 GLM-5.3-Flash 开发 PCP，而对 Qwen-3.8-27B 则没有。

sents.zh: 对于 PCP，注意力机制已经收集了整个块的潜向量 K 𝒞 ( attn ) K_{\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{attn})}。

sents.en: Every rank marks the prefix rows that its lists J i J_{i} , i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} , select in a mask J 𝒞 r J_{\mathcal{C}_{r}} of one byte per prefix row, and one AllReduce with the maximum gives every rank their union J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} over the chunk, less the chunk itself, whose rows every rank already holds:
sents.zh: 每个秩在其列表 J i J_{i}（i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r}）所选的前缀行上做标记，生成每个前缀行占一个字节的掩码 J 𝒞 r J_{\mathcal{C}_{r}}，一次取最大值的 AllReduce 即可让每个秩得到整个块上的并集 J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}}，减去块本身——其各行每个秩都已持有：

paragraphs.en: Each rank then contributes the latents K J 𝒞 , r ( attn ) K_{J_{\mathcal{C}},r}^{(\mathrm{attn})} of the rows of J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} it holds, padded to the largest count over the ranks, to one AllGather , which gives every rank all of J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} . Every rank lays them out with the rows of the chunk in one buffer, K J 𝒞 ∪ 𝒞 ( attn ) K_{J_{\mathcal{C}}\cup\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{attn})} , and remaps J i J_{i} , i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} , onto it. The attention kernel then runs unchanged on the remapped lists. Without the mask, every rank would gather the whole prefix, 1 KiB per row, or 10 GiB per layer at a prefix of T = 10 T=10 M tokens, while the mask costs 1 B per row. Empirically, in our runs of GLM-5.3-Flash on a 10M-token prompt, the union J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} of the index lists of all 32,768 queries of a late chunk covers only about 30% of the prefix, as nearby queries select largely the same keys, so the AllGather moves, and every rank holds, about 30% of the prefix rather than all of it, up to the padding.
paragraphs.zh: 随后每个智能体将其持有的 J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} 各行的潜向量 K J 𝒞 , r ( attn ) K_{J_{\mathcal{C}},r}^{(\mathrm{attn})} 填充到各智能体中的最大行数后，通过一次 AllGather 汇聚，使每个智能体获得完整的 J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} 。 每个智能体将它们与该分块的各行排布在同一个缓冲区 K J 𝒞 ∪ 𝒞 ( attn ) K_{J_{\mathcal{C}}\cup\mathcal{C}}^{(\mathrm{attn})} 中，并把 J i J_{i} （ i ∈ 𝒞 r i\in\mathcal{C}_{r} ）重新映射到其上。 然后，注意力核函数无需改动即可在重映射后的列表上运行。 若没有该掩码，每个智能体都需要汇聚整个前缀，即每行 1 KiB，在 T = 10 T=10 M 个 token 的前缀下每层达 10 GiB，而掩码的代价仅为每行 1 B。 从经验上看，在我们于 1000 万 token 提示上运行 GLM-5.3-Flash 时，后部某个分块的全部 32,768 个查询的索引列表之并集 J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} 仅覆盖前缀的约 30%，因为相邻查询选择的键大体相同，因此在填充允许的范围内，AllGather 传输的、以及每个智能体持有的，仅约为前缀的 30% 而非全部。

sents.en: Empirically, in our runs of GLM-5.3-Flash on a 10M-token prompt, the union J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} of the index lists of all 32,768 queries of a late chunk covers only about 30% of the prefix, as nearby queries select largely the same keys, so the AllGather moves, and every rank holds, about 30% of the prefix rather than all of it, up to the padding.
sents.zh: 从经验上看，在我们于 1000 万 token 提示上运行 GLM-5.3-Flash 时，后部某个分块的全部 32,768 个查询的索引列表之并集 J 𝒞 J_{\mathcal{C}} 仅覆盖前缀的约 30%，因为相邻查询选择的键大体相同，因此在填充允许的范围内，AllGather 传输的、以及每个智能体持有的，仅约为前缀的 30% 而非全部。

paragraphs.en: With GQA, we run attention with TP8 and add DCP8, without PCP: TP splits the prefill by head and computes the keys of the whole chunk on every rank, and DCP splits the KV cache, which is what lets a context of 10M tokens fit on one node. DCP8 replaces the split of the KV heads: every rank holds all four KV heads of the tokens it owns, r j = r r_{j}=r , and gathers the query heads of the other ranks before the indexer and the attention, in prefill and decode. It thus needs neither the partial sums of Equation 13 nor a stored k j ( idx ) k_{j}^{(\mathrm{idx})} : like MLA, it recomputes the index keys of its own tokens from its KV cache.
